title: Assistant Professor in Operations and Supply Chain Digitalisation
description:
The Center for Supply Chain Digitalisation (CSD), at the Department of Technology and Innovation, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for an Assistant Professor in Operations and Supply Chain Digitalization with special focus on simulation and/or artificial intelligence applied to operations and supply chains.

The targeted start date is February 2027.

The successful candidate will be responsible for collaboratively building up the area of operations and supply chain digitalisation with a primary focus on quantitative methods such as discrete-event and agent-based simulation, process automation, data science, and machine learning.

Successful candidates will drive internationally recognized and competitive research, work closely with industry, and are expected to attract external research funding. The position has a strong focus on experimental and applied research in production systems and supply chain fields. The candidate will play a key role in providing outstanding education, supervising bachelor's and master’s students, and developing junior research staff.

SDU CSD is a highly international group of faculty members, embedded in a region with a strong network of companies, including some of Denmark's largest global industrial players (i.e. Danfoss, Linak, Siemens) and many manufacturing SMEs. Projects currently run by the group cover a range of topics within the field of operations and supply chain digitalization.

The successful candidate must have a background in engineering. PhD degree preferably in industrial engineering, supply chain, operations management, operations research, or the like.

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

 

We expect

A highly motivated, collaborative person, who can work in an international, interdisciplinary team, with documented research skills in the field of operations and supply chain. The candidate needs to be a team player and, at the same time, be able to work independently. The successful candidate is active in publishing in engineering journals.

The ideal candidate can connect research with practical technology application and has demonstrated skills and competencies in one or more of the following areas:

  • Discrete-event and/or agent-based simulation

  • Artificial intelligence, machine/deep learning applied to operations and supply chain (AI-applications in other fields are not relevant for this position) 

  • Agentic AI applied to operations and supply chain

  • Business and intelligent process automation

Further information is available from Associate Professor Elias Ribeiro da Silva elias@iti.sdu.dk.

 

We offer

  • A professional workplace culture that values equality, mutual respect, and is designed to accommodate and encourage work-life balance

  • A vibrant social environment with structured activities and informal routines that promote cross-disciplinary interaction and cultivate an inclusive, supportive atmosphere.

  • An engaging, dynamic, and international interdisciplinary environment with extensive collaboration opportunities across national, international, and industrial partners

  • Opportunities for continued professional development and education for all staff members.

  • Access to a well-developed research infrastructure

  • A strong institutional commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in all aspects of the workplace

 

About the workplace

The position is within the SDU Center for Supply Chain Digitalisation (CSD) at the Faculty of Engineering on the international campus Sønderborg. The center conducts research at the intersection of supply chain management, data science, and digital technologies. Our work applies quantitative, data-driven methods to analyse, design, and optimise complex supply chains.

In close collaboration with industry partners, the center focuses on the full data journey across the supply chain, developing tools and methods based on advanced analytics, simulation, and artificial intelligence to enable stronger coordination, end-to-end transparency, and more sustainable and efficient supply chain operations.

SDU CSD is situated in a region with a robust network of companies, including some of Denmark’s largest global industrial players as well as numerous SMEs. The group’s current projects mainly focus on building quantitative models and methods to support better decisions or on turning data-driven optimisation, simulation, and digital tools into practical use in operations. 

The SDU CSD is a highly international and interdisciplinary group of faculty members, with international students. The campus is in Sønderborg, an attractive coastal town with an open Scandinavian culture, and affordable housing and living costs.

 

Special benefits when working in Denmark

  • The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week

  • 30 days of paid holiday per year

  • The yearly salary for a full-time assistant professor is between DKK 502.905 and DKK 566.647 depending on the years of working experience. Postdoc experience may place you on a higher salary step. The salary includes a base salary, a position-related supplement and pension (18.07 %). Additional supplement(s) for special qualifications can be negotiated. Authorisation supplement(s) will be granted, if relevant for the position. Your local eligible trade union representative at SDU negotiates your salary on your behalf.

  • Subsidized preschool childcare and a free education system from primary school up to university level

  • Universal health insurance as a resident of Denmark, including family members officially residing in Denmark

  • In relation to childbirth, employees are entitled to a combined total of 52 weeks of parental leave, shared between parents, with full or partial salary depending on circumstances.

  • Researchers recruited from abroad are offered a special researcher tax scheme with a lower tax rate. 

  • Travel and moving expenses may be partially covered.

 

Living in Denmark

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. Among other things, the staff answers questions concerning salary, taxation, housing and accompanying family.

We recommend that international applicants also take the time to visit Work in Denmark.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

 

Application and assessment

Applications will be assessed by an expert committee. When the expert committee issues its assessment, applicants will receive the portion of the assessment pertaining to them personally.

The committee assesses candidates only based on the application materials. Please include the following documents in English: 

  • Brief motivation letter

  • Curriculum vitae

  • Full list of publications

  • Copies of the three publications on which the applicant wishes to be evaluated. Please attach one pdf-file for each publication

  • Diplomas/Certificates (Master and PhD degree)

  • Summary and documentation of teaching experience. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio.

  • Documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  An interview may be included as part of the overall evaluation of the applicant’s qualifications. If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support. Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply and specific faculty information for application at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period. The preferred start date is from February 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

title: Cleaning Supervisor
description:
Cleaning Supervisor – Full-Time Position in Copenhagen

We are looking for a responsible, well-organised and motivated Cleaning Supervisor to join our team in Copenhagen.

This is a hands-on position combining team supervision, customer communication, quality control and daily cleaning operations. We are looking for someone who enjoys working with people, takes responsibility and can effectively organise both their own work and the work of others.

Your responsibilities

  • Preparing and managing staff schedules and organising shift coverage

  • Maintaining regular contact with employees and coordinating their daily work

  • Communicating with clients and responding to their requests and needs

  • Training, onboarding and supporting new employees

  • Organising training and providing ongoing guidance to the cleaning team

  • Performing regular quality checks and ensuring that our cleaning standards are maintained

  • Ordering cleaning products, equipment and other necessary supplies

  • Cleaning at client locations when required

  • Handling day-to-day operational issues and finding practical solutions

  • Supporting and motivating employees in their daily work

  • Ensuring good communication between employees, management and clients

  • Supporting the company in acquiring and onboarding new clients

We are looking for someone who:

  • Speaks English confidently

  • Is willing and motivated to learn Danish

  • Has strong organisational and communication skills

  • Is comfortable communicating with both employees and clients

  • Is responsible, reliable and able to work independently

  • Can make decisions and solve problems in a busy working environment

  • Is flexible regarding working hours and willing to work in shifts

  • Is available to work every second weekend

  • Is willing to take part in cleaning duties when necessary

  • Living in Denmark is an advantage, but not a requirement. However, you must be willing and able to relocate to Copenhagen for the position

  • Has, or is able to obtain, the legal right to work in Denmark

  • Previous experience in cleaning, supervision, team coordination or a similar position is an advantage

What we offer

We offer a responsible and varied position in a stable and established cleaning company in Copenhagen, where you will play an important role in our daily operations and future development.

Salary: DKK 37,500 gross per month
Working hours: 38 hours per week
Schedule: Shift work, including every second weekend
Location: Copenhagen, Denmark
Employment: Full-time

The work will primarily take place at different client locations across Copenhagen, so flexibility and the ability to organise your working day are important.

We are looking for someone who is not afraid to take responsibility, enjoys working with people and is committed to maintaining high standards of cleaning and customer service.

How to apply

If you are interested in joining our team, please send your CV together with a motivation letter or a short video introducing yourself to:

info@teamclean.dk

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
Department of Food Science
Faculty of Science
University of Copenhagen

The Department of Food Science (FOOD), Faculty of Science (SCIENCE), University of Copenhagen (UCPH) invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor in Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing. The research areas of FOOD have a shared mission to contribute to new pathways for society and industry to support the development of solutions based in biology to improve sustainable food production, food security and food safety. FOOD is recognized for excellence in food research, education and industrial collaboration. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. FOOD has the ambition to reinforce our teaching and research in designing and optimizing biology-based solutions as future sustainable food and ingredient technologies. UCPH is strengthening this area by offering the new MSc Biosolutions program in Kalundborg, Denmark, the largest bio-based manufacturing hub in Scandinavia, home to large fermentation-based manufacturers, and a vibrant innovation environment. The candidate for this position is expected to significantly contribute to this new Biosolutions initiative.

The aim of the position is to explore the production and use of new solutions based on both biology and engineering addressing sustainability challenges inherent in food systems today. Although we welcome a diverse range of applicants, the focus of the position will be processing in relation to biochemically based solutions and could include the following disciplines:

  • Food process technology, ideally with an emphasis on fermentation & downstream processing
  • Food process system engineering
  • Use of sensor technologies such as in-line or at line spectroscopic tools
  • Large-data, modelling and prediction of food and ingredient processes.
  • Understanding of biological production systems and their use, and with an emphasis on downstream processing
A central part of the activities anchored to this position will be taking place in Campus Kalundborg, and it is crucial that the candidate is able to leverage the local ecosystem to foster strong collaboration with industry. Qualifications are expected in the following areas:

  • A collaborative and innovative mindset
  • Documented scientific impact and outreach in past research work
  • A proven track record in attracting external funding at both national and international level
  • Experience with international collaborations
  • Ability to establish industrial collaboration
  • Excellent interpersonal and communicative skills
Tenure-track assistant professor
The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations regarding publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within Ingredient Biochemical Processing. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties.

The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact.

Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered.

Associate professor

Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.

The candidate must be an inspiring teacher with a vision on teaching development, especially in connection with the new MSc Biosolutions program. A new campus with research and teaching facilities is currently being built in Kalundborg and the candidate is expected to contribute to setting up the facilities

Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department.

Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered.

University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit
General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.

Please read more here

For tenure-track assistant professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdf

For associate professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5b_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Associate_professors.pdf

Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here

The tenure-track assistant programme
The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures.

Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields.

After a 6-year tenure-track period tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen.

Salary and employment conditions
The position is open from 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

Employment is as either tenure track assistant professor or associate professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

The Professor will be a part of the Section for Ingredients and Dairy Technology. The section has internationally acknowledged expertise within novel sustainable processing technologies, protein, polyphenol and lipid chemistry, functionality, and modification of food components, kinetics, oxidation, food engineering, rheology, digitalisation, and advanced data analysis. The section is also equipped with pilot facilities for brewing, dairy and bioprocessing. Further information on the Department is linked at Department of Food Science – University of Copenhagen Inquiries about the position can be made to Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department, Colin Ray (+45 93565911, colin.ray@food.ku.dk) or Head of Section, Mogens Larsen Andersen (+45 3533 3262, mola@food.ku.dk).

Filing of application
The position may be applied for at the tenure-track assistant professor level or associate professor level. Please note that it is possible to apply at more than one level. If applied at more than one level, separate applications must be submitted (see below).

The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include

  • Curriculum vitae including:
    • Please describe and document international network and relations
    • Please describe and document internationally based activities
    • Positions held at universities/research institutions outside Denmark
    • Outreach activities, i.e. popular lectures or other activities in the media
    • Grants held, personal or in part. Career development grants.
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan - description of current and future research plans
  • If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications- please describe and document:
    • Experience with supervision of BSc and MSc students
    • Teaching experience
    • Formal pedagogical training
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of up to 5 particularly relevant papers
Applying for the associate professorship please include

  • Curriculum vitae including information about external funding
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan – description of current and future research plans
  • Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers
The deadline for applications is 28 October 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.

After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.

You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

Interviews will be held on 8 March 2027.

Please refer to the following no. in future communication in this case:

211-0263/26-2N, Tenure-track Assistant Professor Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing.

211-0760/26-2E, Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing.

title: Dynamics 365 F&O Developer
employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
description:
Build the financial engine behind global sustainable impact

 

Do you want to build and evolve the financial technology platform that enables investments — from climate and health to food systems worldwide? And are you ready to play a pivotal technical role in one of the most ambitious digital transformations in Danish development finance?

At Impact Fund Denmark, you join a mission-driven organisation with a clear purpose — to finance projects that bring sustainable development to life, from forestry in Paraguay to solar energy in Brazil and diagnostics in Bangladesh.

Here is what you get with us:

  • A central role in evolving our Dynamics 365 F&O platform

  • Collaboration with skilled colleagues, data engineers, and business stakeholders in a friendly, inclusive culture

  • Access to the full Microsoft enterprise stack in a modern, tech-driven environment

 

Global impact, strong IT culture and meaningful teamwork

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark's development finance institution, investing in sustainable solutions that create measurable impact in developing countries. While headquartered in Copenhagen, our work extends across more than 45 countries, supported by six regional offices, uniting 24 nationalities under one purpose.

You will be part of the Technology & Operations team, which is currently expanding, including specialists in processes, architecture, data, and IT Security. Here, you will join experienced and collaborative professionals who are eager to share knowledge and support each other across disciplines.

Please note:

  • This position operates out of our main office in Copenhagen, and regular presence at the office is required. 

  • While we welcome applications and are open to candidates from outside of Denmark, please note that Impact Fund Denmark will not provide relocation assistance.

 

The team

A place where great ideas can come from anyone

Joining us means becoming part of a warm, ambitious, and genuinely collaborative Technology & Operations Team. We are a group that thrives on shared purpose, celebrates each other's wins, and is not afraid to roll up our sleeves when things get complex. Our work spans a broad range of initiatives that shape the organisation's digital backbone — but what truly defines us is how we do it: together.

You will be surrounded by talented colleagues who bring curiosity, professionalism, and a healthy sense of humour to the table. We challenge each other, support each other, and take pride in creating solutions that make a real difference across the organisation. As we continue to grow and evolve, we are building a culture where learning is continuous and where you will have the space to influence how we work.

 

You develop and evolve our D365 F&O platform

We are looking for a Dynamics 365 F&O Developer to take a key role in developing, customising, and maintaining the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations platform that underpins our financial operations and reporting globally. You will work closely with our Solution Architect, Business Application Manager, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust, scalable, and well-governed solutions.

 

You will, for example:

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy customisations and extensions in Dynamics 365 F&O

  • Integrate D365 F&O with other systems in our stack, including Dynamics 365 CE, Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, and third-party SaaS applications

  • Configure and optimise financial modules including General Ledger, Accounts Payable/Receivable, Fixed Assets, Project Accounting, and Budgeting

  • Collaborate with the Solution Architect to align development work with our enterprise architecture principles and integration patterns

  • Participate in and contribute to requirements workshops, translating business needs into technical designs and functional specifications

  • Support and maintain existing D365 F&O configurations, data entities, and custom solutions — and troubleshoot issues as they arise

  • Contribute to DevOpsSec practices, including ALM, source control, release management, and deployment pipelines

  • Produce clear technical documentation and support knowledge transfer within the team

 

You bring deep F&O expertise and a collaborative mindset

With your background in Dynamics 365 F&O development and configuration, you understand how to turn complex financial requirements into well-engineered solutions that stand the test of time.

 

We imagine that you:

  • Hold a relevant degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience

  • Have solid hands-on experience developing in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations

  • Are comfortable configuring core financial modules and translating business processes into D365 workflows

  • Have experience with integration patterns and tools, such as Data Entities, OData, Logic Apps, or Azure Integration Services

  • Understand the Power Platform ecosystem (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse) and how it connects to F&O

  • Are familiar with Lifecycle Services (LCS), Azure DevOps, and CI/CD practices for D365

  • Communicate clearly with both engineers and business stakeholders — bridging the technical and functional worlds

  • Desirably have experience from the financial sector or international development finance

 

Our technology stack

Our current environment is built on Microsoft technology and continues to evolve. You will work with:

  • Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O)

  • Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE)

  • Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse)

  • Microsoft Fabric & Azure Data Services

  • Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, and more)

  • Several fit-for-purpose SaaS solutions and integrations

 

What we offer

  • An opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects with real social and environmental impact

  • A collaborative, value-driven, and international work environment

  • Opportunities for professional development, training, and continuous learning

  • A brand-new office with modern facilities close to Nordhavn Metro and S-Train station

 

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark's Development Finance Institution. We aim to be a best-in-class impact investor by making commercial private sector investments that support the green transition, as well as building just and inclusive societies in developing countries and emerging markets. Impact Fund Denmark has a strong focus on creating sustainable and responsible businesses, which generate measurable social, economic, and climate impacts as well as solid financial returns.

title: Frøbjerg-Orte Friskole, Børnehave og Vuggestue søger pædagogmedhjælper/pædagogisk assistent til vores børnehave/vuggestue.
description:
Er du initiativrig, nysgerrig og drømmer du om at være en del af:

- en medarbejdergruppe, der har fokus på udvikling, og hvor der er plads til grin og forskellighed?

- et hus, hvor der er højt til loftet, skønne omgivelser og en kultur båret af højt fagligt niveau?

 

Så er det dig, vi har brug for!

 

Vores hus er opdelt i 2 grupper:

Yngstegruppen er vores vuggestue, og den er inddelt i tre grupper: Hoppelopperne, Løbebillerne og Springfrøerne.

Ældstegruppen er vores børnehave, og den er inddelt i Græshopperne, som er de ældste og kommende skolebørn, Mariehøns og Sommerfugle for de 3-4-årige.

Alle børn tilknyttes hver deres gruppe og primære voksne, samtidig med, at vi laver hverdagsaktiviteter på tværs af grupperne, når det giver mening.

 

Vi har en ledig stilling i vores børnehave på 30-34 timer.

Vi ser værdien i at bringe de ansattes kompetencer i spil i for alle børn og da vi dagligt både morgen og eftermiddag arbejder på tværs af Yngste og Ældste, skal du være åben for at kunne se dig selv i hele huset.

 

Vores pædagogik hviler på et fundament af grundmotorik og sanseintegration, altid bakket op af anerkendelse, nærvær, tilknytning og stjernestunder. Der skal være plads til udfoldelse og tid til fordybelse sammen med børnene og børnene imellem.

Vores naturskønne område med skov i baghaven og Frøbjerg Bavnehøj som nærmeste nabo, lægger op til en aktiv hverdag præget af aktiviteter både ude og inde. Kun fantasien sætter grænser…... også for de voksne.

 

Vi lægger stor vægt på fællesskabets betydning for alle børn. Ved at understøtte den enkeltes udvikling, sikrer vi barnets mulighed for at føle sig inkluderet og som en del af en helhed.

Vi prioriterer et tæt forældresamarbejde, hvor vi i fællesskab altid sigter mod at vende vilkår til muligheder.

 

Vi drømmer om at:

 

·         Du elsker udelivet og ser uderummet som en integreret del af børnelivet.

·         Du har stor interesse for, og gerne erfaring med sanseintegration og børns motoriske udvikling.

·         Du er optaget af LEG og Langsom Pædagogik, og du understøtter naturligt børnenes egne initiativer og fordybelse.

·         Du har fagligheden i fokus og reflekterer gerne over egen og andres praksis.

·         Du kan se dig selv i en personalegruppe, hvor der er plads til livsglæde, humor, selvstændighed, fleksibilitet og gå på mod.

·         Du får øje på fordelene i at være en del af friskolelivet, -det tværfaglige samarbejde og den røde tråd på hele Frøbjerg-Orte Friskole, Børnehave og Vuggestue.

 

Frøbjerg-Orte Friskole, Børnehave og Vuggestue rummer tilsammen pt. 185 skoleelever, 47 børn på Ældstegruppen og 33 børn på Yngstegruppen. Stedet drives af en forældrevalgt bestyrelse, bakket op af forældreråd i børnehave/vuggestue.

 

Vi er ca. 48 medarbejdere fordelt mellem lærere, pædagoger, pædagogmedhjælpere, studerende, forretningsfører samt praktisk personale. Ledelsen består af Konstitueret Skoleleder og Pædagogisk Leder.

 

Hvordan ansøger du?

 

Stillingen er til ansættelse pr 1. december 2026.

 

Vi ser meget gerne at du prioriterer at komme og besøge os, da det giver os mulighed for at vise dig alt det vi kan tilbyde og samtidig kan du mærke stemningen i huset. Ring til os for at lave en aftale om besøg.

 

Ansøgningsfrist er senest d. 5. oktober 2026. Samtaler vil blive afholdt løbende.

 

Ansøgning og bilag sendes som en PDF til: ansoegning@fofri.dk Skriv dit navn i emnefeltet.

Du kan læse og se meget om os på vores hjemmeside http://www.fofri.dk

 

Personlig kontakt til pædagogisk leder: Rikke Skovhøj tlf. 54552155 mail: bhleder@fofri.dk

eller konstitueret skoleleder Kim Hedegaard tlf. 25143454 mail: viceleder@fofri.dk

 

Ansættelse sker i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst ”aftale om løn – og ansættelse for pædagogisk personale i de frie grundskoler”.

 

Hvis du ikke har hørt fra os inden d. 30. oktober 2026, er stillingen besat til anden side.

Din ansøgning vil blive opbevaret i 6 mdr. Herefter bliver den slettet.

title: Postdoctoral Position in Animal Welfare Risks of Feeding Red Seaweed to Dairy Cows
description:
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Aarhus University, calls for applications for a full-time postdoctoral position. The two-year position is available from 1 February 2027, or soon thereafter. The position will be in the research unit Behaviour, stress and welfare (BSW).

Dairy cattle contribute substantially to agricultural greenhouse gas emissions, primarily through enteric methane production, making the identification of effective nutritional mitigation strategies an important area of research. While the feed additive Bovaer has received considerable attention for its methane-reducing effects, concerns regarding animal health and welfare have led to increasing interest in alternative solutions, including seaweed-based feed additives. The seaweed Asparagopsis spp. has shown significant methane-mitigating potential; however, its use has also raised animal welfare concerns. Consequently, there is a need to evaluate the animal welfare effects of seaweed-based feed additives.

Research tasks
  • Evaluating the effects of seaweed-based feed additives on the behaviour and welfare of dairy cattle.
  • Investigating behavioural indicators of discomfort and pain associated with feed management.
  • Validating welfare assessment measures through experimental approaches, including pharmacological interventions.
  • Contributing to scientific publications and dissemination of research results.
  • Participating in knowledge exchange activities with public authorities and industry stakeholders.
  • Contributing to teaching and supervision of students at the bachelor's, master's, and PhD levels.


Qualifications
We are seeking a candidate who has:
  • A PhD degree or equivalent in biology, animal science, veterinary science, or a related field, and research experience in animal behaviour and welfare.
  • A strong interest in strategies aimed at reducing the climate impact of dairy production through feeding management.
  • At least a basic understanding of feeding management.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to communicate scientific research results effectively.
  • The ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a research environment.
  • For non-Scandinavian candidates, a commitment to learning Danish, including reading, writing, and speaking, is expected during the employment period.


Contact
Further information on the position may be obtained from Professor Margit Bak Jensen, phone: +4522365482, email: margitbak.jensen@anivet.au.dk

What we offer
  • A well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment and animal experimental facilities
  • An informal and multicultural research environment with high professionalism and close collaboration and networking activities
  • A workplace characterized by equality and a good work-life balance, and an open discussion across different fields of research.


The candidate will have the opportunity to be trained and gain experience in:
  • Teaching and supervision of students at the BSc and MSc level through active involvement in teaching in animal science and in the veterinary science programme.
  • Research-based consultancy to authorities, where it is relevant.


Who we are
Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences is well-known for its skilled and very innovative interdisciplinary research environments with high international impact. We perform world-class research, which contributes with solutions to solve essential societal challenges within the green transition: food production and veterinary medicine – nationally and globally.

The department generates novel research at the highest international level within sustainable food production, environment, climate, health and welfare for animals and humans. The activities form the basis for the research-based public sector consultancy and degree programs covering bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degree programs within animal science and veterinary medicine. We offer a lively, engaged and innovative learning and study environment, which is closely integrated in the research environment.

Our department has unique and advanced animal experimental research facilities and technologies, situated in close connection to the research environment, and a comprehensive national and international research network and good industrial and professional collaboration.

Please refer to Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences (au.dk) for further information about the department: https://anivet.au.dk/en

Place of work and area of employment
The place of work is the Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, AU Viborg,
Blichers Allé 20, DK-8830 Tjele, and the area of employment is Aarhus University (AU) with related departments.

Living in Denmark
Please visit the international staff website: https://internationalstaff.au.dk/prearrival/ for information about arriving to and living in Denmark for both the applicants and their potential families.



Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self.



Formalities and salary range
Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

title: Junior Software Developer
description:
Want to work with sustainability and software? Looking to be part of an innovative, fast-growing Danish greentech company with global reach? Then Explicit might be the place for you.

We are looking for a software developer to join us to develop and maintain our digital platforms as we scale.

We do drone-based emissions monitoring across oil & gas, maritime, waste management, and other industries. By helping operators safely identify methane leaks and quantify emissions, we're proud to be supporting industry efforts to improve environmental performance while enhancing operational efficiency and asset integrity. We measure greenhouse gas emissions data from various sources and combining them with atmospheric data. Based on scientific methods we then quantify emissions and visualize the data to provide emissions intelligence to operations enabling actions on emissions.

We have a strong focus on R&D, and we are exploring new cutting-edge technologies and ideas to innovate what we can do within emissions monitoring.

The job

You will be part of a small, talented tech developer team, responsible for designing, building and maintaining our digital platforms, which are the core of the products we deliver to customers.

As a Software Developer your responsibilities will include:

  • Co-development of our main applications Microsoft Azure, Blazor Server Application (C#)

  • Co-development of our calculation engine, Microsoft Azure Function (Python)

  • Develop new, more appealing user experiences aimed at different user groups to view products and services.

  • Maintain databases, application services and reporting landscape specific to the European maritime emission monitoring set-up.

  • Improve analysis tools and the user experience for the customers, the drone pilot and the internal project manager in collaboration with the project manager running the campaigns.

About you

We are looking for a candidate who meets the following criteria:

  • A bachelor's degree or master’s degree in engineering, data science, software design, computer engineering, mathematics, physics or similar

  • Experience with code development in C# and Python and preferable Rust

  • Experience with database design (SQL)

  • Familiar with software development processes in Azure DevOps

  • Experience with development of user interfaces and UX design is an advantage, but not a requirement

  • Fluent in English. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement

  • Genuine interest in technology and IT infrastructure

  • Structured and focused on delivering quality work and being a good team player.

 

What we offer

  • A permanent, full-time position in a fast-growing greentech company with real-world impact on cutting industrial emissions

  • Competitive benefits including paid pension, health insurance, parental leave and 6 weeks' holiday allowance

  • Software ownership early on, with senior developers to learn from

  • A flat hierarchy where ideas are heard, initiative is encouraged, and responsibility comes early

  • A supportive team that values collaboration, trust and learning

  • Job location is just north of Copenhagen in Virum, Denmark.

Application and information

We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we will be evaluating applications on an ongoing basis. Application deadline is 18 October 2026. Expected start date is 1 November 2026.

Please send your application, including your motivation and what a competence you bring, together with your CV to jobs@explicit.dk. Write “Software developer” in the subject field.

If you have any questions about the job, you are welcome to contact Rasmus Ebdrup, Chief Digital Officer at reb@explicit.dk

___________________________________________________________________________________

About Explicit

Explicit ApS is a pioneering Danish green tech company specialising in drone-based emissions monitoring across the energy, maritime, waste management, and other industries. We deliver reliable, transparent and actionable emissions data to some of the largest energy companies all over the world using our patented drone-based methodology.

We are headquartered in Virum, Denmark, with offices in Norway, Germany and Australia. Our international team of around 30 colleagues brings together engineering, data and environmental expertise, united by a shared mission to make a difference in emissions monitoring. Read more about what we do at explicit.dk

description:

Er du typen, der læser en tegning, tænder for svejseapparatet og er stolt af det, der kommer ud i den anden ende? RENTEQ Automotive er en startup i vækst, og vi har brug for en dygtig smed til at svejse de trailere, rammer og dele, der indgår i hver eneste maskine, vi konverterer. Om RENTEQ Automotive

Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Vi tilbyder

title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project in renal calcium transport
description:
Declaration of interest regarding PhD project in renal calcium transport

 

The laboratory of Henrik Dimke, Cardiovascular and Renal Research Unit at the Department of Molecular Medicine, University of Southern Denmark is seeking a highly motivated PhD student in the field of renal transport physiology. Particular emphasis will be placed on signalling through the calcium-sensing receptor and the regulation of renal calcium transport in transgenic models.

 

Research environment

The PhD student will join the laboratory of Professor Henrik Dimke in the Cardiovascular and Renal Research Unit. The laboratory studies epithelial ion transport and the mechanisms that maintain calcium, magnesium, and phosphate balance, with particular emphasis on renal calcium transport, the calcium-sensing receptor, claudins, and kidney stone disease. The Research Unit focuses on innovative molecular and biomedical research related to cardiovascular and renal physiology. We offer a stimulating, international research environment where English is the preferred language at meetings and seminars. You will work in the modern NytSUND building, which is directly connected to the new Odense University Hospital and provides state-of-the-art laboratory and animal facilities. You can read more about the department and institute here.

 

Project description

The project will investigate how altered calcium-sensing receptor (CASR) signalling disrupts the endocrine and renal control of calcium homeostasis. Particular attention will be given to autosomal dominant hypocalcaemia type 1, in which excessive CASR activity suppresses parathyroid hormone secretion and promotes renal calcium loss. The project will examine the signalling mechanisms linking CASR activation to renal calcium transport and whole-body calcium balance. The successful applicant will use clinically relevant genetic models, including inducible and cell-specific transgenic approaches, together with detailed physiological characterization, molecular and biochemical techniques, and imaging.

 

Qualifications

Qualified and highly motivated candidates from all nationalities are encouraged to apply. 

 

The successful applicant must have

  • A Master's degree (Danish: kandidatgrad) or another relevant degree that concludes a research-based study programme of minimum five years’ duration at an institution of higher education. If you do not have a Master's degree, the Graduate School will make an individual assessment of your academic qualifications.

  • Good oral and written English language skills

  • you must at the time of submission have documented research experience. E.g. be the author or co-author of an article in a peer-reviewed international journal (must at least be submitted) or of a published abstract from an international scientific conference, or have worked as research assistant full time for at least 6 months (after completing your masters degree). The research experience of each applicant is individually assessed by the Graduate School.

 

The successful applicant should have

  • The ability to work independently and in a structured manner. 

  • Good collaborative and interpersonal skills. 

  • Previous experience with experimental animal work or relevant molecular and biochemical techniques, such as western blotting or immunohistochemistry, is preferred but not required.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:

Professor Henrik Dimke

Department of Molecular Medicine

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

Tel. +45 65 50 83 10 E-mail: hdimke@health.sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• A letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)

• • Contact details for at least one professional reference who may be contacted during the assessment process.


Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. References will normally be contacted only for shortlisted candidates.

Further information about the PhD-program can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. 

 

Closing date: October 12th, 2026


Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

 

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order).

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

 

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.

 

As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

Vi tilbyder

title: Har du el-teknisk baggrund og kendskab til fordelingstavler, så mangler vi dig!

title: Lageroperatør til varemodtagelsen (daghold)
description:
Har du solid erfaring med truckkørsel, og vil du være en del af et stærkt team på en stabil arbejdsplads med ambitiøse planer for fremtiden? Så er du måske vores nye kollega i varemodtagelsen hos ABENA Produktion.

Du bliver en del af et engageret daghold bestående af 10 lageroperatører. Vi arbejder selvstændigt, tager ansvar for vores opgaver og hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det. Du bliver en vigtig del af et team, hvor tillid, samarbejde og ordentlighed er centrale værdier.

Vi oplever høj aktivitet og udvider derfor teamet med en ny kollega. Samtidig investerer vi markant i fremtidens produktion og øger kapaciteten i de kommende år. Du bliver dermed en del af en virksomhed med langsigtede ambitioner og høj stabilitet.

Som lageroperatør i varemodtagelsen er din vigtigste opgave at sikre, at råvarer og emballage modtages, kontrolleres og indlagres korrekt, så produktionen kan køre effektivt.

Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:

  • udføre modtagekontrol og indgangskontrol

  • modtage og ankomstmelde interne og eksterne biler

  • læsse og tømme biler med råvarer og emballage

  • føre palleregnskab

  • gennemføre optællinger

  • håndtere afvigelser

  • sikre orden og struktur i lagerområdet

  • løse ad hoc-opgaver i afdelingen

Du ansættes på fast daghold. Der kan dog i perioder forekomme arbejde på skiftehold.

Arbejdstiderne er: mandag til onsdag: kl. 06.00-14.35, torsdag: kl. 06.00-14.20, fredag: kl. 06.00-13.00.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • har erfaring fra et lignende job og flere års erfaring med truckkørsel

  • er fortrolig med at bruge PC som arbejdsredskab

  • behersker dansk i skrift og tale

  • arbejder struktureret og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • bidrager positivt til samarbejdet i teamet

  • Kendskab til ERP-systemet SAP er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Din kommende leder fortæller

"Som lagermedarbejder værdsætter jeg frihed under ansvar. Det er afgørende, at vi tager ejerskab for vores arbejdsdag, både i udvikling og i vedligeholdelse af rutiner. Når man arbejder med mennesker, er tillid, retfærdighed og samarbejde fundamentet for et godt arbejdsmiljø. Kommunikationen er central, og vi taler til hinanden med respekt og ligeværd." - Bo Hansen, Afdelingsleder Lager

Derfor skal du vælge ABENA

Hos ABENA bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor vi investerer i fremtiden, udvikler vores produktion og skaber rammerne for langsigtet vækst. Samtidig får du hverdagen i et stærkt team, hvor der er plads til både ansvar, faglighed og godt humør. Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • frihed under ansvar

  • engagerede og hjælpsomme kolleger

  • mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling

  • kantineordning

  • motionsrum

  • sundhedsordning

  • en række attraktive personalegoder

Hos os skal det være sjovt at gå på arbejde. Samtidig sætter vi en ære i at være ordentlige over for hinanden, vores leverandører og naturen.

Ansøgning

Er du klar til at blive en del af holdet? Send din ansøgning og dit CV ved at klikke på "Ansøg".

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Bo Hansen, Afdelingsleder Lager, på telefon 28939917.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Site Manager Isolering Danmark (m/k/d) - Site Manager Insulation - Site Manager Isolierung – Dänemark (m/w/d) Denmark (m/f/d) -
description:
See desription in English below

Siehe Beschreibung auf Deutsch unten

Dansk:

TL Concept er en veletableret produktions- og entreprenørvirksomhed, der er specialiseret i teknisk isolering, pladekapper, ventilationskanaler og brandbeskyttelse. Med mange års erfaring og ca. 600 dygtige medarbejdere, leverer vi løsninger af høj tysk kvalitet til byggeprojekter i hele Europa. TL Concept oplever stærk vækst, og Danmark er et af vores strategiske vækstområder. Vi har etableret et dansk selskab med dansk ledelse. www.tlconcept.eu      

 

Vi er kendt for vores fokus på innovation, præcision og en kundecentreret tilgang. Vores mål er at skabe bæredygtige og effektive løsninger, der lever op til vores kunders krav om kvalitet, samtidig med at vi sikrer et sikkert og inspirerende arbejdsmiljø for vores medarbejdere. Hos TL Concept er vi stolte af vores stærke teamkultur, hvor samarbejde og udvikling er i centrum. Vi tror på, at motiverede medarbejdere skaber de bedste resultater, og derfor prioriterer vi uddannelse og personlig udvikling.

 

Vi søger en engageret Site Manager Isolering til vores team. Hos os får du mulighed for spille en nøglerolle i store byggeprojekter, der involverer teknisk isolering, pladebeklædning, ventilationskanaler og passiv brandbeskyttelse

 

Som Site Manager bliver du ansvarlig for at drive vores byggeprojekter fremad. Du kommer til at spille en central rolle i at sikre udførelse af høj kvalitet, effektiv projektstyring og sikkerhed på byggepladsen. Du arbejder tæt sammen med et team på ca. 15 isolatører og montører, og din arbejdsdag vil være præget af ansvar og variation.

 

VI TILBYDER

·   Et ansvarsfuldt og afvekslende job i en dynamisk virksomhed med vindermentalitet

·   Ansættelse efter dansk lov i dansk datterselskab

·   Ægte holdånd, åben kommunikation og uformel arbejdsatmosfære

·   Professionelle processer og korte beslutningsveje

·   Firmabil og firmabetalt mobiltelefon

·   Løn efter kvalifikationer og mulighed for sundhedsforsikring

·   Løbende videreuddannelse og spændende projekter

 

FAGLIGE OG PERSONLIGE FORUDSÆTNINGER

·   Flere års erfaring som Site Manager inden for byggeledelse

·   Erfaring med montering – særligt af teknisk isolering, og gerne pladekapper, ventilation og brandbeskyttelse

·   Serviceorienteret, pålidelig og i stand til at motivere både sig selv og medarbejdere

·   Ansvarlig og kvalitetsbevidst , loyal, ærlig og vindende personlighed

·   Villig til at rejse til aktuelle byggeprojekter i Danmark (vi har aktuelt projekter på Sjælland 1 år frem)

·   Taler min. et af de skandinaviske sprog og engelsk. Kan du tysk er det et plus, men ikke et krav

·   Arbejdstilladelse i EU samt kørekort (kategori B)

·   Erfaren bruger af Office-pakken

 

DINE OPGAVER

·   Byggeledelse: Herunder koordinering af projekter og deadlines, ordrebehandling og materialeplanlægning, fakturerings- og økonomisk ansvar og daglig overblik over montagepersonale

·   Arbejdsmiljø og sikkerhed: Herunder sikre orden og sikkerhed på byggepladserne, overholde arbejdsmiljøregler og koordinere ferieplanlægning

·   Uddannelse og vejledning: Herunder uddanne, evaluere og udvikle teknisk personale i samarbejde med Projektlederen

·   Kvalitet og kommunikation: Herunder løbende overvågning og forbedring af kvalitet og produktivitet samt sikre god kommunikation og støtte til kunder og projektleder

Send dit fyldestgørende ansøgningsmateriale på dansk engelsk eller tysk per e-mail, inklusive cv, lønforventning og tilgængelighed, til Jørgen Villadsen: jorgen.villadsen@tlconcept.eu

 

For spørgsmål er du velkommen til at kontakte Jørgen per e-mail.

 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

English:

TL Concept is a well-established manufacturing and contracting company specialising in technical insulation, sheet metal cladding, ventilation ducts and fire protection. With many years of experience and approx. 600 skilled employees, we deliver solutions of high German quality to construction projects throughout Europe. TL Concept is experiencing strong growth, and Denmark is one of our strategic growth areas. We have established a Danish company with Danish management. www.tlconcept.eu

We are known for our focus on innovation, precision and a customer-centric approach. Our goal is to create sustainable and efficient solutions that fulfil our customers' demands for quality while ensuring a safe and inspiring work environment for our employees. At TL Concept, we are proud of our strong team culture, where collaboration and development take centre stage. We believe that motivated employees create the best results, which is why we prioritise training and personal development.

We are looking for a dedicated Site Manager Insulation to join our team. With us, you will have the opportunity to play a key role in large construction projects involving technical insulation, cladding, ventilation ducts and passive fire protection

As a Site Manager, you will be responsible for driving our construction projects forward. You will play a key role in ensuring high-quality execution, efficient project management and safety on site. Working closely with a team of around 15 insulators and fitters, your working day will be characterised by responsibility and variety.

WE OFFER

·   A responsible and varied job in a dynamic company with a winning mentality

·   Employment under Danish law in a Danish subsidiary

·   True team spirit, open communication and an informal working atmosphere

·   Professional processes and short decision-making processes

·   Company car and company-paid mobile phone.

·   Salary according to qualifications and the option of health insurance

·   Continuous training and exciting projects

 

PROFESSIONAL & PERSONAL PREREQUISITES

·   Several years of experience as a Site Manager in construction management

·   Experience in installation - especially technical insulation, and preferably sheet metal cladding, ventilation and fire protection

·   Service-orientated, reliable and able to motivate yourself and staff

·   Responsible and quality-conscious, loyal, honest and winning personality

·   Willing to travel to current construction projects in Denmark (we currently have projects on Zealand 1 year ahead)

·   Speaks min. one of the Scandinavian languages and English. German is a plus, but not a requirement

·   EU work permit and driving licence (category B)

·   Experienced user of Microsoft (Office, Excel, PowerPoint e.g.)

 

YOUR TASKS

·   Construction management: incl. coordination of projects and deadlines, order processing and material planning, invoicing and financial responsibility and daily overview of assembly staff

·   Health & safety: Incl. ensuring order and safety on construction sites, complying with health and safety regulations and coordinating holiday planning

·   Education & supervision: Incl. training, evaluating and developing technical staff in co-operation with the Project Manager

·   Quality & communication: Incl. continuous monitoring and improvement of quality and productivity as well as ensuring good communication and support to customers and project manager

Send your complete application material in Danish, English or German by email, including CV, salary expectations and availability, to Jørgen Villadsen: jorgen.villadsen@tlconcept.eu

For questions, you are welcome to contact Jørgen by e-mail.

TL Concept ist ein etabliertes Produktions- und Bauunternehmen, das sich auf technische Isolierungen, Blechverkleidungen, Lüftungskanäle und Brandschutz spezialisiert hat. Mit langjähriger Erfahrung und ca. 600 qualifizierten Mitarbeitern liefern wir Lösungen von hoher deutscher Qualität für Bauprojekte in ganz Europa. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n Site Manager Isolierung. Bei uns haben Sie die Möglichkeit, eine Schlüsselrolle bei großen Bauprojekten in den Bereichen technische Isolierung, Verkleidung, Lüftungskanäle und passiver Brandschutz zu spielen.

Als Site Manager sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, unsere Bauprojekte voranzutreiben. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit einem Team von rund 15 Isolierern und Monteuren wird Ihr Arbeitsalltag von Verantwortung und Abwechslung geprägt sein.

WIR BIETEN 

·   Eine verantwortungsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem dynamischen Unternehmen mit Gewinnermentalität

·   Eine Anstellung nach dänischem Recht in einer dänischen Tochtergesellschaft

·   Echten Teamgeist, offene Kommunikation und eine ungezwungene Arbeitsatmosphäre

·   Professionelle Prozesse und kurze Entscheidungswege

·   Firmenwagen und ein vom Unternehmen bezahltes Mobiltelefon.

·   Ein Gehalt, das der Qualifikation entspricht, und die Möglichkeit einer Krankenversicherung

·   Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung und spannende Projekte

 

FACHLICHE & PERSÖNLICHE VORAUSSETZUNGEN

·   Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Bauleiter im Baumanagement

·   Erfahrung im Montagebereich - insbesondere technische Isolierung, vorzugsweise Blechverkleidung, Lüftung und Brandschutz

·   Serviceorientiert, zuverlässig und in der Lage, sich selbst und Mitarbeiter zu motivieren

·   Verantwortungsvolle und qualitätsbewusste, loyale, ehrliche und gewinnende Persönlichkeit

·   Bereitschaft, zu aktuellen Bauprojekten in Dänemark zu reisen (wir haben derzeit Projekte auf Seeland, die 1 Jahr vor uns liegen)

·   Spricht mindestens eine der skandinavischen Sprachen und Englisch. Deutsch ist ein Plus, aber keine Bedingung

·   EU-Arbeitserlaubnis und Führerschein (Kategorie B)

·   Erfahrener Anwender von Microsoft (Office, Excel, PowerPoint u.a.)

 

IHRE AUFGABEN

·   Baumanagement: inkl. Projekt- und Terminkoordination, Auftragsabwicklung und Materialdisposition, Rechnungsstellung und Finanzverantwortung sowie täglicher Überblick über das Montagepersonal

·   Gesundheit & Sicherheit: Inkl. Sicherstellung von Ordnung und Sicherheit auf den Baustellen, Einhaltung der Arbeitsschutzbestimmungen und Koordination der Urlaubsplanung

·   Ausbildung & Betreuung: Schulung, Bewertung und Entwicklung des technischen Personals in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Projektleiter

·   Qualität & Kommunikation: Inkl. kontinuierliche Überwachung und Verbesserung von Qualität und Produktivität sowie Sicherstellung einer guten Kommunikation und Unterstützung von Kunden und Projektmanager

title: Praktisk stærk servicemedarbejder til MARTECs brandskole i HVIMS
employer: Den selvejende institution MARTEC - Maritime and Polytechnic College
description:
Er du praktisk anlagt, serviceorienteret og god til at skabe struktur i en hverdag med mange forskellige opgaver? MARTEC søger en servicemedarbejder med en håndværksmæssig baggrund til vores brandskole HVIMS.

Du bliver en vigtig del af den daglige drift og skal være med til at sikre, at brandskolens bygninger, øvelsesområder og udstyr fremstår funktionelle, sikre og klar til undervisning og kursusaktiviteter.

Om stillingen

Som servicemedarbejder på MARTECs brandskole får du en alsidig og praktisk hverdag. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med brandskolens instruktører og øvrige medarbejdere og får en central rolle i forbindelse med klargøring, drift og vedligeholdelse.

Arbejdsopgaverne varierer fra dag til dag. Du skal derfor trives med en hverdag, hvor der både er planlagte vedligeholdelsesopgaver og opgaver, som skal løses med kort varsel. Stillingen kræver, at du kan arbejde selvstændigt, tage initiativ og bidrage aktivt til at få de daglige aktiviteter til at fungere.

Dine opgaver

Dine primære opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • klargøre øvelsesområder og udstyr til undervisning og kursusaktiviteter

  • rydde op og genetablere øvelsesområder efter gennemførte aktiviteter

  • udføre løbende drift og vedligeholdelse af bygninger, udendørsarealer og teknisk udstyr

  • udføre mindre håndværksmæssige reparationer og praktiske opgaver

  • vedligeholde og reparere metaldele og udstyr, herunder eventuelt udføre mindre svejseopgaver

  • planlægge vedligeholdelsesopgaver og følge op på arbejde udført af eksterne håndværkere

  • bidrage til korrekt og bæredygtig affaldshåndtering

  • hjælpe instruktørerne med praktiske opgaver i forbindelse med brandskolens aktiviteter


Kvalifikationer

Om dig

Vi tilbyder

title: Vi søger betonchauffør til Unicon i Trekantsområdet
description:
Vil du køre nogle af Danmarks mest ikoniske lastbiler og være med til at levere fundamentet for fremtidens byggeri?

Hos Unicon søger vi en betonchauffør til vores fabrikker i Trekantsområdet. Som betonchauffør hos os er du meget mere end chauffør. Du er en vigtig del af støbningen og den, der sikrer, at betonen kommer sikkert frem, i den rette kvalitet og på det rigtige tidspunkt.

Du trives naturligvis bag rattet i en stor bil, men mindst lige så vigtigt er det, at du kan samarbejde med kollegerne på fabrikken og med kunderne på byggepladserne. Alle dage afsluttes på fabrikken, så du slipper for overnatninger i bilen.


Du bliver en vigtig del af byggepladsen

 

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du betonen fra fabrikken til byggepladsen, hvor du samarbejder med både kunden, pumpechaufføren og kollegerne om at få støbningen til at forløbe som planlagt.

Du leverer ikke bare et produkt – du er med til at sikre, at byggeriet kan fortsætte.

Nogle leverancer losses direkte fra bilens bånd, mens andre overføres til en betonpumpe. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du kan samarbejde med de mennesker, der modtager betonen, og bidrage til, at arbejdet udføres sikkert og effektivt.

Du kommer til at navigere på byggepladser, hvor pladsen ofte er trang, og hvor præcision og overblik er afgørende. Det kræver gode køreevner, sikkerhedsfokus og evnen til at holde hovedet koldt, når forholdene er udfordrende.


Mere byggeplads end landevej

 

Hvis du drømmer om lange ture gennem Europa, er dette nok ikke det rette job.

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du typisk mange korte ture mellem fabrikken og lokale byggepladser. Til gengæld bliver du en del af byggeprojekterne og får en hverdag med tæt kontakt til kunder, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere.

Det er et job for dig, der kan lide variation, ansvar og en arbejdsdag, hvor du gør en synlig forskel.


Hvem er du?

 

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har stort kørekort inkl. hænger/trailer (CE)

  • Har EU-bevis

  • Har fokus på din egen og andres sikkerhed

  • Trives med at køre og manøvrere store køretøjer under krævende forhold

  • Er serviceminded og professionel i mødet med kunderne

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine leverancer

  • Har fysik til rengøring og vedligeholdelse af bilen

  • Holder orden omkring dig og dit materiel

Det er en fordel, hvis du har krancertifikat eller erfaring fra bygge-, entreprenør- eller transportbranchen, men det er ikke et krav.


Derfor skal du vælge Unicon

 

Hos Unicon bliver du en del af Danmarks førende betonproducent og et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor sikkerhed, kvalitet og samarbejde går hånd i hånd.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Branchens bedste ansættelsesforhold

  • Grundig oplæring og introduktion til jobbet

  • Moderne materiel og gode arbejdsforhold

  • Betalt arbejdstøjsordning inklusive vask

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder – både fagligt og personligt

  • En unik holdånd og stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

  • Overenskomst gennem Dansk Industri og 3F

  • En hverdag med selvstændighed og ansvar

En arbejdsdag, hvor kunderne er med til at sætte dagsordenen

 

Som betonchauffør er din arbejdsdag styret af byggepladsernes behov og dagens leverancer.

Du får typisk besked om mødetid den følgende dag om eftermiddagen, når næste dags produktion og leverancer er planlagt. Arbejdsdagen slutter, når den sidste tur er kørt og bilen er vasket. Du kommer derfor hjem hver dag og slipper for overnatninger i bilen. Derfor er det ikke et traditionelt 7-15-job, og nogle dage kan blive kortere end forventet, mens andre dage bliver længere. Overarbejde forekommer jævnligt, men bliver naturligvis honoreret, og vi har gode muligheder for både udbetaling og opsparing af afspadsering, som mange af vores chauffører bruger til hele fridage.

Hvis du trives med variation, ansvar og en hverdag, hvor opgaven bliver gjort færdig, vil du passe godt ind hos os.


Sådan bliver du en del af holdet

 

Med udgangspunkt fra en eller flere af vores fabrikker i Trekantsområdet bliver du en del af et stærkt team af chauffører og kolleger, som hver dag arbejder sammen om at levere beton til nogle af områdets vigtigste byggeprojekter.

Du refererer til fabrikkens daglige leder.

Kan du se dig selv i rollen, hører vi gerne fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte fabriksleder Tobias Meier Jørgensen på telefon 2871 4678 eller områdechef Kent Florczak på telefon 29254481.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi finder den rette kandidat.

 

Om Unicon 

Unicon Danmark tilbyder lige muligheder for alle og har aktivt fokus på at fremme et arbejdsmiljø, der er fri for diskrimination, og hvor medarbejdere behandles med værdighed og respekt. I vores virksomhed er ansættelse baseret på den enkeltes fortjenester og kvalifikationer, som er direkte relateret til kompetencekrav i jobbet. Vi diskriminerer ikke nogen medarbejder eller jobansøger baseret på race, etnicitet, nationalitet, herkomst, genetiske oplysninger, statsborgerskab, religion, alder, køn, kønsidentitet/udtryk, seksuel orientering, graviditet, civilstand, handicap eller andre beskyttede karakteristika efter gældende love eller regler. Vi overholder disse principper i alle aspekter af ansættelse, herunder rekruttering, ansættelse, uddannelse, kompensation, forfremmelse og fordele.

title: Seasonal Worker wanted with forklift certificate – for the pumpkin season 2026
description:
About Thorsbjerggaard

Thorsbjerggaard is a Danish farm specializing in the cultivation of edible pumpkins. Our products are supplied to many major Danish supermarkets and specialty stores. We also grow peas, squash, and watermelons.

All work is carried out on the farm, including cultivation, harvesting, washing, and packing.

A valid forklift certificate is an advantage and will be preferred.

The certificate must be valid for use in Europe.

Only applicants with a forklift certificate will be considered for the position.

Working Period

As soon as possible – end of March 2027

Working Hours

During warm periods, work usually starts at 5:00 a.m. and continues until around 12:00 noon. During busy periods, additional work in the afternoon may be required.

Working hours may vary depending on the weather and workload. Part-time work may occur. You will have at least one day off per week.

Language Requirements

You must be able to speak and understand English.

Wages

Monthly salary

Registered with the Danish tax authorities (SKAT)

Salary paid directly into your bank account, with a pay slip

Requirements

  • You must be at least 18 years old.

  • EU citizenship (a valid passport or national ID card is required).

  • Good physical condition, motivation, and a positive attitude.

  • Farm or harvesting experience is an advantage but not required.

  • A clean criminal record certificate from your home country.

We Expect You To

  • Be reliable and arrive on time.

  • Be flexible and willing to help wherever needed.

  • Work well as part of a team with people from different cultures.

  • Be able to communicate in English.

Accommodation

We have a campsite located on the farm, where you can rent a space in a caravan. Each caravan can accommodate up to four people.

Beds with mattresses are provided, but you must bring your own sleeping bag and bed linen.

The campsite offers access to toilets, showers, laundry facilities, shared cooking facilities (you prepare your own meals), and internet access.

The accommodation fee is all-inclusive.

The cost of accommodation in a caravan is DKK 70 per person per day. A refundable deposit of DKK 1,500 is required and will be returned if everything is left in the same condition as when you arrived.

Holiday Allowance

Holiday allowance will be transferred to FerieKonto and paid according to Danish holiday regulations.

Hygiene Rules

All hygiene regulations relating to the handling and harvesting of food products must be strictly followed. You will receive detailed instructions before starting work.

Failure to follow the hygiene rules may result in immediate dismissal without further warning.

What to Bring

  • Please remember to bring:

  • Sleeping bag

  • Warm clothing

  • Practical work clothes

  • Boots and waterproof clothing

  • Even in good weather, the plants can be very wet in the morning.

Important Documents

You must bring:

  • A valid national ID card (and passport, if possible)

  • A valid IBAN bank account in your own name

  • Documentation proving that you have health insurance in your home country

  • Tax Information 2026

  • You must bring documentation showing that you have a permanent address in your home country.

  • If you worked for us last year and have had other jobs since then, please bring documentation from your most recent employer.

  • If you are married, documentation of your marital status is required.

  • Please bring copies of all original documents, as well as English translations.

How to Apply

Please send your application and relevant documents to:

job@thorsbjerggaard.dk

If you do not hear from us within two weeks, please assume that your application was unsuccessful and that we are unable to offer you a position for 2026.
