title: Service Engineer
description:
**Location: Vantaa, Finland**

At ADB SAFEGATE, we are shaping the future of airport performance. Our solutions help airports operate more safely, efficiently, and sustainably — from aircraft approach to gate departure.

To strengthen our service team in Finland, we are looking for a motivated and hands-on **Service Engineer** to support our customers with advanced airport technology solutions.

**Your Mission**

In this role, you will be an important part of our technical team, ensuring that mission-critical airport systems are commissioned, maintained, and supported to the highest standards.

You will:

- Perform servicing, preventive maintenance, commissioning, and diagnostics of ADB SAFEGATE hardware and software systems, both on-site and remotely.

- Maintain and update technical documentation.

- Provide technical expertise and support to our customers.

- Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders while independently taking ownership of assigned tasks.

- Conduct on-site surveys and prepare technical reports.

- Represent ADB SAFEGATE professionally in all customer interactions.


**Your Profile**

We are looking for a practical, ambitious, and reliable professional who enjoys solving technical problems, working directly with customers, and taking ownership in an international environment.

**Required qualifications**

- A degree or professional qualification in Electrical Engineering, Automation Technology, Computer Science, IT, or a comparable technical field.

- Hands-on experience with electrical, automation, control, or industrial IT systems, including confidence in using technical tools, test equipment, and diagnostic software.

- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify faults across hardware, software, electrical, and control systems.

- Practical experience with low- or medium-voltage equipment and the ability to read electrical drawings and wiring diagrams.

- Professional working proficiency in Finnish and English, with the ability to communicate technical information clearly to customers and international colleagues.

- Willingness to travel up to 30%, including occasional short-notice assignments. Some commissioning and service activities may take place outside standard working hours.

- A valid Category B driving licence and willingness to travel independently to customer sites.

- Ability to manage assigned service and commissioning tasks independently while collaborating effectively with international engineering, project, and customer support teams.

- Strong customer-facing communication skills and the ability to provide professional technical support, guidance, and updates.

- A proactive and responsible approach, with strong quality awareness, customer focus, and ownership of assigned tasks.


**Preferred qualifications**

- Previous experience as a Field Service Engineer, Commissioning Engineer, System Engineer, Service Technician, or in a similar customer-facing technical role.

- Experience with airport systems, airfield lighting, industrial infrastructure, or other safety- or operationally critical systems.

- Practical knowledge of PLC systems, switchgear, control equipment, and industrial automation.

- Experience administering and troubleshooting Windows and/or Linux operating systems.

- Working knowledge of SQL databases, including basic diagnostics, queries, and system support.

- Familiarity with scripting or programming languages used for diagnostics, configuration, automation, or system integration, such as Python, Bash, batch scripting, C#, or JavaScript.

- Experience with cloud-connected systems, remote monitoring solutions, networking, or remote support tools.

- A relevant Finnish electrical safety qualification. Candidates who are eligible and willing to obtain the required qualification may also be considered.

- Knowledge of other European languages.


**What We Offer**

At **ADB SAFEGATE**, you will join an innovative industry leader where your work directly contributes to safer and smarter airport operations worldwide.

**We offer:**

- A role in a global company setting benchmarks in airport safety, efficiency, and technology.

- A dynamic work environment with challenging and meaningful projects.

- International cooperation with experienced colleagues and customers.

- Flat hierarchies, open communication, and modern working models.

- The friendly atmosphere of a medium-sized company combined with the strength of a global organization.

- Opportunities for personal development, technical training, and professional growth.

- Opportunities to work on customer projects in Finland and across Europe.

- A varied, practical, and engaging role where no two days are the same.


**Ready to Help Airports Move Smarter?**

If you are passionate about technology, enjoy hands-on fieldwork, and want to be part of an international team delivering critical airport solutions, we would like to hear from you.

**Join ADB SAFEGATE and help shape the future of safe, efficient, and sustainable airport operations.**

title: Analyst (Commercial Projects & Financial Analysis), Uusimaa
description:
About the role

In this role, you will be the analytical backbone for senior commercial leads and project managers across high-stakes energy deals. Your day-to-day focus will center on hands-on quantitative work, building and running diverse Excel models for investment calculations, deal valuations, and complex partnership structures. You will analyze broad commercial cases - ranging from long-term PPAs and joint ventures to corporate structures and M&A activities and translate your findings into clear presentations for decision-makers. Rather than working in a static setup, you will navigate a fast-moving, agile environment where project priorities evolve quickly. This position is an ideal next step for an ambitious analyst with some experience from transaction advisory, investment banking, or consulting who enjoys quantitative modeling and wants to apply their skills directly inside an industry leader.

You are offered
You will work on high-stakes commercial cases presented directly to executive leadership while receiving close guidance and support from experienced senior professionals. The position offers strong long-term career advancement and internal mobility within the company, along with a balanced hybrid work model including a few remote days per week.

Work tasks

This role focuses on providing quantitative support and financial modeling for large-scale energy projects and strategic business developments.
- Supporting senior leads on large-scale customer and partnership deals
- Building detailed Excel models for investment calculations, valuations and contract structures
- Performing market and corporate finance analysis for joint ventures and M&A projects
- Turning quantitative data into clear slides and presentations for management and clients
- Utilizing AI tools (e.g., Copilot) to speed up analysis and reporting

We are looking for

- University degree in Finance, Economics or a related field
- Some experience in analyst roles (e.g., from consulting, advisory, corporate finance, or M&A)
- Strong Excel skills for hands-on financial modeling and investment calculations
- Solid foundation in Corporate Finance principles and valuation methods
- Strong quantitative abilities and comfort working with complex data
- Ability to present and explain financial findings clearly to stakeholders
- Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken)

Please note that a security clearance will be conducted for the chosen candidate, and any offer of employment is conditional upon a successful security clearance check.

It is meritorious if you have
- Good knowledge of Finnish or Swedish
- Familiarity with the energy industry or large-scale infrastructure investments
- Background in Corporate Finance studies
- Experience with asset or portfolio optimization analysis

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
- Detail-oriented and structured
- Change-oriented

- Proactive

- Intellectually curious

title: Lähihoitaja, sosiaalihuollon resurssiyksikkö, Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue

Odotamme, että sinulla on aikaisempaa työkokemusta alalta ja osaamista asiakastyöstä sekä kuntoutuksesta. Erityisesti arvostamme positiivista ja iloista asennetta sekä hyviä yhteistyötaitoja.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Esimiehen täyden tuen ja hyvät työtoverit
- Mahdollisuuden kehittyä monipuolisessa työssä
- Joustavat työajat ja työskentely-ympäristön, joka tukee hyvinvointiasi ja ammatillista kehittymistäsi.

Jos sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidot, positiivinen asenne ja intoa työskennellä eri ihmisryhmien kanssa, voit olla etsimämme henkilö. Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!

Tervetuloa osaksi tiimiämme!

Lähihoitajan tutkinto tai terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun asetuksen (564/1994) tai valtioneuvoston sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilöistä antaman asetuksen (153/2016) mukainen tutkinto.
Tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito maamme molemmissa kansalliskielissä

Valitulla tulee olla voimassa tartuntatautilain (1227/2016) 48 § mukainen rokotussuoja. Lisäksi valitun tulee esittää rikosrekisterilain 6 § 2. mom. tarkoitettu ote rikosrekisteristä.

Sovelletaan koeaikaa.

title: Auraaja
description:
Haemme auraajia talvikaudelle Helsingin ja Vantaan alueella sijaitseviin omiin asiakaskohteisiimme.

Työ on kutsuttaessa tehtävää lumenaurausta. Työvuorot määräytyvät sää- ja lumiolosuhteiden mukaan, joten kuljettajalta edellytetään hyvää tavoitettavuutta ja valmiutta lähteä töihin tarvittaessa myös aikaisin aamulla, öisin ja viikonloppuisin.

title: Project Procurement Manager
description:
Join us in building a sustainable society powered by clean energy and reliable connections! We are now looking for Project Procurement Manager in Helsinki or Rauma. The position can also be based in any of our other offices in Finland. We offer flexible hybrid working opportunities.

As a Project Procurement Manager, you play a critical role in ensuring successful project delivery. You are responsible for planning and executing procurement activities throughout the project lifecycle, from customer tendering and project kick-off to final delivery and close-out.

Working closely with project teams, category management, suppliers, and business stakeholders, you ensure that projects have the right suppliers, materials, subcontractors, and services available at the right time, cost, and quality. Through proactive procurement leadership, supplier management, and risk mitigation, you contribute directly to project profitability, schedule performance, delivery reliability, and customer satisfaction.

Tasks and responsibilities:
* Lead end-to-end procurement planning and execution
* Act as the main procurement contact for project stakeholders
* Manage sourcing processes (supplier selection, RFQs, negotiations, contracts)
* Ensure optimal total cost of ownership and savings
* Monitor supplier performance and manage supplier issues, claims, and onboarding
* Build and maintain key supplier relationships
* Oversee purchase orders, deliveries, and logistics
* Ensure accurate procurement data in ERP systems
* Identify and mitigate procurement risks
* Ensure compliance with policies, contracts, and regulations
* Maintain proper documentation and audit trails
* Integrate ESG and sustainability into sourcing decisions and promote responsible supplier practices

Requirements:
* Relevant degree (e.g. Supply Chain, Business, Engineering)
* 5+ years of procurement experience in project-based environments
* Strong negotiation, analytical, and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution
* Fluent in English and Finnish

Are you up for the challenge? Come and create the best customer experiences with us!

The application period ends on 11.10.2026. However, please send your application as soon as possible, as we may begin interviews during the application period and fill the position once the right candidate is found.

For more information about the position, please contact: Jonna Katavisto, Talent Acquisition Partner, +358 44 360 6783, jonna.katavisto@enersense.com. Call times Thu 24.9. between 11-12 and Thu 1.10. between 9-10.

title: Raskaan kaluston asentaja (Pirkanmaa)

title: Service Desk Technician
description:
**Service Desk Technician**

JOB PURPOSE

Serve as the first point of contact for Curium employees and partners worldwide, providing timely, high-quality technical assistance through the Global Service Desk. Log, diagnose, resolve and/or escalate incidents and service requests in line with agreed SLAs, while contributing to knowledge and continuous service improvement.

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE ROLE

- Provide first-line support via Freshservice, phone, chat and email; ensure accurate ticket creation and lifecycle updates.

- Troubleshoot and resolve incidents related to end-user devices, operating systems, Microsoft 365, collaboration tools and approved business applications.

- Fulfil service requests (software installation/configuration, access requests, equipment requests) following standard procedures and security policies.

- Support user onboarding/offboarding: account setup coordination, workstation readiness, and user guidance on core tools and security best practices.

- Use remote support tools to assist users; collaborate with local IT/field services when hands-on intervention is required.

- Escalate complex issues to the appropriate resolver groups (workplace, network, server, security, applications) with clear diagnostics and evidence.

- Create and maintain knowledge base articles, procedures and troubleshooting guides; contribute to reducing repeat incidents.

- Maintain accurate asset and user device records in Freshservice and ensure data quality for reporting and compliance.

- Communicate clearly and professionally with users, providing status updates and setting expectations throughout the resolution process.

- Participate in shift coverage and (where applicable) on-call/major incident support according to the Global Service Desk operating model.

- Backfill the field service desk technician on request.


WHAT YOU NEED FOR THIS POSITION

**Must have Experience/Skills:**

- Bachelor's degree in IT (or equivalent professional experience).

- 2+ years in a Service Desk / IT support role in an international environment.

- Demonstrated experience working with ITSM processes (Incident, Request, Knowledge) and SLAs.

- Strong troubleshooting skills on Windows and common end-user hardware/peripherals.

- Good knowledge of Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

- Familiarity with identity and access concepts (Active Directory / Entra ID), MFA and basic security hygiene.

- Experience with remote support tools and endpoint management basics (Intune / Autopilot / SCCM) is advantageous.

- Basic networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, WiFi, VPN, connectivity troubleshooting).

- Excellent customer service mindset; ability to prioritize and work under time pressure.

- Fluent in Finnish and English (written and spoken); additional languages are a plus.


**Nice to have Experience/Skills:**

- Hands-on experience with Freshservice (or equivalent ITSM tool) including knowledge article creation.

- ITIL Foundation certification or practical ITIL experience.

- Experience supporting Teams telephony / conferencing room equipment.

- Exposure to regulated environments (GxP) and validated processes.

title: Perhefutiksen ja kerhojen ohjaaja
description:
Laajasalon Palloseura on helsinkiläinen vuonna 1978 perustettu 1000 pelipassipelaajan ja lähes 1500 harrastajan jalkapalloyhteisö, jonka pääasiallisena toiminta-alueena on Laajasalon saari ja sen lähiympäristö.

Etsimme ohjaajia perhefutikseen, lasten jalkapallokerhoon ja aikuisten jalkapallokouluun.

Voit olla taustaltasi vaikka liikunnanohjaaja, fysioterapeutti, liikunnanopettaja, urheilija tai valmentaja. Pääasia on, että saat ohjaamasi ryhmän innostumaan liikkumisesta ja motivoitumaan liikunnasta ja jalkapallosta.

Harrasteryhmissä tärkeintä on liikunnan ilon sytyttäminen ja ylläpito sekä monipuolisten liikuntataitojen opettaminen. Toimintaa tehdään kuitenkin jalkapalloympäristössä ja jalkapallon keinoin, joten jonkinlainen jalkapallotausta olisi hyvä olla olemassa. Jalkapallovalmentajatausta ei ole pakollinen.

Työntekijältä toivomme myös hyvää organisointikykyä ja kykyä tulla toimeen niin lasten kuin aikuistenkin kanssa.

Työ on pääasiassa ilta- ja viikonloppupainotteista. Tarjoamme tarpeen mukaan valmennuskoulutusta sekä tukea valmennukseen.

Tarkistamme valittavalta työntekijältä rikostaustaotteen.

- Lasten kanssa työskentelyyn vaaditaan rikosrekisteriote, joka perustuu lakiin lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä (504/2002).

title: Training Coordinator
description:
The Wärtsilä Land & Sea Academy (WLSA) is responsible for delivering high-quality learning services to customers and employees around the world. Our training portfolio supports Wärtsilä's innovative technologies and solutions across the marine and energy sectors, helping customers develop the skills needed for a more sustainable future.


We are now looking for an enthusiastic Training Coordinator to join our Training Coordination team in Vaasa, Finland. Whilst we offer hybrid working, the operational nature of our business often requires attendance on site, and occasional flexibility outside normal working hours may be required.

In this role, you will be at the heart of our global training operations, working closely with customers, instructors, sales teams, and business stakeholders to ensure an outstanding learning experience from initial enquiry to training completion. You will combine customer service, operational coordination, digital tools, and continuous improvement to deliver successful training programmes that create value for our customers and Wärtsilä.


If you enjoy working in an international environment, building strong relationships, and coordinating multiple activities simultaneously, this could be your next career opportunity.



What will you be doing?


As a Training Coordinator, you will manage and coordinate the end-to-end training delivery process while ensuring a seamless customer experience.


Your responsibilities will include:


Training Operations



* Coordinate training delivery activities at the Vaasa Training Centre and other assigned learning environments.
* Manage course scheduling, participant registrations, notifications, reporting, and training documentation.
* Maintain training records and related data in SAP, Learning Management Systems, and other digital platforms.
* Coordinate resources (instructors, classrooms, workshop) allocation.
* Support training delivery and help resolve operational challenges quickly and effectively.
* Monitor customer feedback and identify opportunities to improve services and processes.



Customer and Business Support


* Support the planning, promotion, and execution of training activities for internal and external customers.
* Create and maintain training offerings and service packages.
* Collaborate with sales, account management, contract management, and business stakeholders to promote learning solutions.
* Support internal and external communication activities related to training services.


What will help you succeed?



We are looking for someone who combines strong coordination skills with a passion for customer service and continuous improvement.


You will ideally have:



* A Bachelor's or Master's degree, or equivalent relevant work experience.
* Experience with Learning management systems (LMS), training administration, learning operations, customer service, project coordination, or a similar role.
* Experience working with SAP and Salesforce would be considered an advantage.
* Strong digital skills and confidence in learning new systems and technologies.
* Excellent, organisational and multitasking abilities. You will be adept at coordinating evolving requirements and will frequently need to adapt to factors outside your control.
* A structured and detail-oriented way of working.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* A proactive mindset and ability to identify and implement improvements.
* Ability to work under pressure and prioritise tasks effectively. You will be empowered to make decisions within your scope to advance your workload.
* A customer-focused approach and commitment to delivering high-quality service.
* Fluent English skills, both written and spoken.
* Finnish language skills are considered an advantage.


Why join us?


At Wärtsilä Land & Sea Academy, you will become part of a global learning organisation that plays a key role in developing the competencies needed for the future of energy and marine industries. We believe that great results come from empowered people. We encourage ownership, accountability, and collaboration, creating an environment where individuals can contribute, develop, and make a meaningful difference.


As part of our global learning organisation, you will work alongside experienced professionals in a culture built on respect, inclusion, and continuous learning. We value openness, encourage new ideas, and see challenges as opportunities to improve. Everyone is encouraged to bring their authentic self to work and contribute their unique perspective.


We particularly appreciate candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and commitment to professional growth. Experience gained across different functions, projects, or disciplines is highly valued, as it helps us build agile teams capable of supporting a diverse and evolving business environment.

title: Iltapäiväkerhon ohjaajan sijainen
employer: Helsingin Nuorten Miesten Kristillinen Yhdistys ry
description:
**Etsimme reippaita, luotettavia ja lasten kanssa viihtyviä sijaisia iltapäiväkerhoihimme kaudelle 2026–2027.**

Sijaisena pääset työskentelemään osana iltapäiväkerhon ohjaajatiimiä ja tekemään merkityksellistä työtä lasten parissa. Sijaisuudet voivat olla **yksittäisiä päiviä tai pidempiä sijaisuusjaksoja**, joten työ sopii hyvin esimerkiksi opiskelijalle, osa-aikatyötä etsivälle tai henkilölle, joka haluaa tutustua kasvatusalaan käytännössä.

Työvuorot sijoittuvat pääosin **arkisin kello 11–17 välille**.

**Mitä sijaisen työ iltapäiväkerhossa on?**

Iltapäiväkerhon sijaisena osallistut yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa lasten turvallisen ja mielekkään iltapäivän rakentamiseen.

**Työhösi kuuluu esimerkiksi:**

- lasten vastaanottaminen ja heidän turvallisuudestaan huolehtiminen

- leikkien, pelien, ulkoilun ja muun toiminnan ohjaaminen

- lasten kohtaaminen ja tukeminen erilaisissa arjen tilanteissa

- välipala- ja siirtymätilanteissa avustaminen

- sovittujen sääntöjen ja päivittäisten rutiinien ylläpitäminen

- yhteistyö iltapäiväkerhon muun henkilöstön kanssa


Et jää työssä yksin, vaan työskentelet osana iltapäiväkerhon tiimiä ja saat perehdytyksen työtehtäviisi.

**Toivomme sinulta:**

- aitoa kiinnostusta työskennellä lasten kanssa

- positiivista ja kannustavaa tapaa kohdata lapsia

- luotettavuutta ja vastuullisuutta

- kykyä toimia osana työyhteisöä

- joustavuutta muuttuvissa arjen tilanteissa

- riittävää suomen kielen taitoa lasten ja työyhteisön kanssa toimimiseen


Aikaisempi kokemus lasten tai nuorten kanssa työskentelystä katsotaan eduksi, mutta **kaikissa sijaisuuksissa kasvatusalan koulutus tai pitkä työkokemus ei ole välttämätön**. Tärkeintä on hyvä asenne, vastuullisuus ja halu toimia lasten kanssa.

**Tarjoamme sinulle:**

- mahdollisuuden tehdä merkityksellistä työtä lasten parissa

- perehdytyksen iltapäiväkerhon toimintaan

- kokeneen työyhteisön tuen

- mahdollisuuden saada työkokemusta kasvatusalalta

- vaihtelevan työn, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole täysin samanlainen

- mahdollisuuden tehdä sijaisuuksia oman tilanteesi mukaan


Sijaisena toimiminen on myös hyvä tapa tutustua toimintaamme. Haemme säännöllisesti uusia työntekijöitä pidempiin työsuhteisiin, joten hyvin sujunut sijaisuus voi avata mahdollisuuksia myös myöhempään työskentelyyn kanssamme.

Jos olet vastuullinen, tulet toimeen erilaisten ihmisten kanssa ja haluat olla mukana rakentamassa lapsille **turvallista, iloista ja kannustavaa iltapäivää**, jätä meille hakemuksesi.

description:

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

- Aikaisempaa kokemusta hitsaajan työstä

- MIG/MAG- ja/tai TIG-hitsauksen osaamista

title: Automation Engineer
description:
We at Rocsole are experts in electrical tomography and its application to industrial process monitoring. Our unique SeeBeyond technology helps customers detect and visualize liquids, solids, and interfaces in demanding industrial environments. Our LiquiDetect and SoliDetect products support safer, more efficient, and more sustainable operations. Our customers include major industrial and energy companies around the world.

We are looking for an **Automation Engineer** to join **#TeamROCSOLE**!

In this position, you will create and maintain electrical and automation documentation for Rocsole products, including wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, cable drawings, and other related technical documentation. You will provide technical support throughout the product lifecycle and contribute to customer projects, commissioning activities, troubleshooting, and after-sales support together with Rocsoles Technical Support team.

You will work closely with our product development, production, and technical support professionals. Your responsibilities will include supporting electrical and functional testing, maintaining accurate product documentation, and ensuring that product modifications are properly reflected in drawings and technical materials.

You will also participate in factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), commissioning, and startup activities. When required, you will support customers remotely or on-site. Occasional international travel is therefore part of the role.

The right candidate is a structured and detail-oriented professional with strong problem-solving skills. You are comfortable working independently, but you also collaborate effectively with colleagues, customers, and other stakeholders. You take pride in producing accurate technical documentation and providing professional support in practical engineering situations.

**Your main responsibilities will include:**

- Creating and maintaining wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, cable drawings, and related technical documentation for Rocsole products

- Ensuring that electrical documentation meets Rocsoles quality standards, applicable requirements, and customer needs

- Updating drawings and documentation when product modifications and engineering changes are implemented

- Supporting production personnel with electrical and automation-related technical issues

- Supporting electrical and functional testing of products before shipment

- Participating in verification and validation activities for new products and product modifications

- Supporting commissioning and startup activities together with Rocsoles Technical Support Specialist

- Participating in factory acceptance testing (FAT) and site acceptance testing (SAT)

- Providing remote and on-site technical support when required


**We expect you to have:**

- A bachelors degree or equivalent qualification in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or another relevant technical field

- Relevant work experience in electrical schematic and wiring diagram design

- Experience with SolidWorks Electrical, DraftSight, or equivalent electrical design tools

- Basic knowledge of PLCs and automation systems

- Strong attention to detail and a structured, systematic approach to your work

- Good problem-solving, communication, and customer service skills

- Ability to work both independently and as part of a team

- Fluent verbal and written communication skills in English

- Willingness to travel internationally on occasion


Equivalent competence acquired through relevant work experience may also be considered.

**The following will be considered an advantage:**

- Experience in designing and documenting 230 VAC industrial electrical systems

- A valid SFS 6002 Electrical Safety Training certificate

- Knowledge of the SFS 6000 electrical installation standards

- Experience with industrial instrumentation and sensors

- Experience with industrial communication networks

- Understanding of Ex, ATEX, or IECEx requirements


Our company embraces personal and professional growth. If you are looking for practical engineering challenges and an opportunity to develop your expertise in industrial automation, instrumentation, and sensor technology, this could be the right place for you.

Our office is located in Kuopio, Finland, where your workstation and colleagues are waiting for you. The position is full-time and permanent. Occasional international travel is required.

**We shape the future of industrial process monitoring. Come join us! More info at: https://rocsole.co/AutEng**

Millainen henkilö sopii tehtävään?

Etsimme henkilöä, joka on:

- **Erittäin oma-aloitteinen ja vastuuntuntoinen**

- Täsmällinen ja luotettava

- Hyvä suunnittelemaan omaa ajankäyttöään

- Itsenäinen – et tarvitse jatkuvaa ohjausta

- **Päätöksentekokykyinen – uskallat tehdä ratkaisuja itse**

- Järjestelmällinen ja osaat luoda järjestystä myös tilanteissa, joissa sitä ei vielä ole

- Nopea oppimaan uusia asioita ja järjestelmiä

- Tietokoneen ja verkkopalveluiden kanssa sujuvasti toimiva

- Myynnillisesti ajatteleva ja tuloshakuinen

- **Aktiivinen sosiaalisessa mediassa**

Tämä työ ei sovi sinulle, jos:

- Sinun on vaikea suunnitella omaa ajankäyttöäsi

Meillä tuotteita tulee jatkuvasti lisää, joten **tässä työssä pitää saada aikaan tulosta ja asioita pitää viedä eteenpäin joka päivä.**

title: Lähihoitaja, kotihoito, Tampere
description:
Lielahden kotihoidossa palvelemme noin 115:tä asiakasta kolmessa tiimissä. Teemme päivittäin tiivistä yhteistyötä tiimissämme toimivan erillisen P1-etähoivan yksikön kanssa. Moniammatillisen työyhteisömme yhteinen tavoite on tarjota asiakkaillemme laadukasta hoitoa ja tukea heidän omannäköistään arkeaan kotona. Hyödynnämme työssämme aktiivisesti hyvinvointiteknologiaa ja kehitämme kotihoidon palveluja yhdessä.

Lähihoitajana työskentelet kotihoidon vaativissa ammattitehtävissä ja vastaat asiakkaiden hoidon suunnittelusta, toteutuksesta ja arvioinnista. Työ on monipuolista, vastuullista ja ihmisläheistä. Työskentelet asiakkaiden kodeissa sekä itsenäisesti että työparin kanssa ja teet yhteistyötä asiakkaiden, heidän läheistensä sekä muiden hoitoon osallistuvien ammattilaisten kanssa. Tiimitilamme sijaitsevat hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella, aivan ratikkareitin tuntumassa. Asiakaskäynneillä voit liikkua yksikön autolla tai sähköpyörällämme. Jos käytettävissäsi on auto, voit hyödyntää myös sitä työssä liikkumiseen. Voimassa oleva B-luokan ajokortti ja mahdollisuus käyttää autoa helpottavat työssä liikkumista.

Tarjoamme sinulle
Laadukkaan perehdytyksen: pääset alkuun kokeneen työkaverin rinnalla.
Itsenäisen, vaihtelevan ja ratkaisukeskeisen työn sekä vahvan tiimin tuen.
Mahdollisuuden kehittää ammatillista osaamistasi.
Lämminhenkisen ja avoimen työyhteisön, jossa vallitsee rento ja keskusteleva ilmapiiri ja työhyvinvoinnista huolehditaan yhdessä.

Odotamme sinulta
Olet sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilörekisteriin merkitty nimikesuojattu lähihoitaja tai perushoitaja.
Sinulla on hyvät työyhteisö- ja tiimityötaidot sekä valmius itsenäiseen työskentelyyn.
Sinulla on paineensietokykyä, kykyä toimia muuttuvissa tilanteissa ja työn edellyttämä hyvä fyysinen toimintakyky.
Suhtaudut myönteisesti teknologian hyödyntämiseen hoitotyössä ja haluat kehittää työtä yhdessä muiden kanssa.
Sinulla on hygieniapassi ja tehtävän edellyttämät LOVe-lääkehoidon verkkotestit (LOP, PKV, GER1) hyväksytysti suoritettuina ennen työsuhteen alkamista.

Katsomme eduksi aiemman työkokemuksen kotihoidosta.

Toivomme, että voit aloittaa tehtävässä mahdollisimman pian, sovimme aloituksesta kanssasi erikseen. Toinen tehtävistä päättyy 1.11.2026 ja toinen 10.1.2027. Koeaika on enintään puolet palvelussuhteen pituudesta. Työaika on kokoaikatyö, keskimäärin 38 tuntia 15 minuuttia viikossa. Työhön sisältyy aamu- ja iltavuoroja. Tehtävään valitun on esitettävä rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 4 momentin mukainen rikosrekisteriote ennen työsuhteen alkamista. Suosittelemme vahvasti tartuntatautilain (1227/2016) 48 §:n mukaista rokotesuojaa.

Tule mukaan reiluun ja rempseään työyhteisöömme tekemään merkityksellistä työtä, jolla mahdollistamme asiakkaillemme hyvän arjen. Jätäthän hakemuksesi Kuntarekry -rekrytointijärjestelmässä.

title: Project Engineer, ABB Marine & Ports
description:
We are looking for a motivated Project Engineer to join ABB Marine & Ports and support the delivery of advanced marine electrical, propulsion, and control system projects.

This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or an early-career engineer who wants to develop technical expertise within a global engineering organization and gain hands-on experience in international delivery projects.

Your responsibilities

As a Project Engineer, you will:

- Support Lead Engineers in delivery project engineering and design activities
- Assist in technical problem-solving throughout the project lifecycle
- Participate in Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and related engineering activities
- Prepare and maintain technical documentation
- Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams on system integration and troubleshooting
- Contribute to the development and improvement of engineering processes and ways of working
- Support project teams in ensuring successful project execution and delivery

You will have the opportunity to work with systems such as:

- Generators
- Main switchboards and power distribution systems
- Transformers
- Converters and drives
- Propulsion Control Systems (PCS)
- Remote Control Systems (RCS)
- Dynamic Positioning (DP) systems
- Marine automation and control systems

What we are looking for

To succeed in this role, we hope you have:

- Degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related field
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Good written and spoken English communication skills
- Ability to work effectively in an international project environment
- A proactive attitude and willingness to learn
- Interest in electrical systems, automation, and engineering projects

Considered an advantage

- Familiarity with EPLAN or other electrical design tools
- Knowledge of IEC or IEEE standards
- Previous project, internship, or thesis experience related to electrical engineering or automation
- Interest in marine technology and power systems

What we offer

- Opportunity to work with world-leading marine technologies
- Exposure to challenging international delivery projects
- Great opportunities for professional growth and development

Submit your application as soon as possible, as we will review applications and interview suitable candidates during the application period. The position will be filled once a suitable candidate has been found.

Please note that, for GDPR and data security reasons, we are unable to process applications submitted by email or through other channels. To be considered for the position, please submit your application through our recruitment system on our website.

title: Process Engineer (Surface Treatment)
description:
Type: permanent, full-time

Location: Perniö, Turku, Tampere, Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa, Oulu, remote

Application deadline: 28.9.2026

Want to develop surface treatment processes in an international environment and impact production quality and efficiency? Wipro is looking for a Process Engineer!

**What will you be doing?**

We are looking for a Process Engineer to join Wipro Infrastructure Engineering as a technical expert in surface treatment. You will develop and evaluate new and existing surface treatment methods at Wipros manufacturing sites and support production, R&D, and other teams in technical matters. Your work will focus especially on industrial painting and pretreatment processes, corrosion testing, and improving process quality and efficiency.

Your projects may include reducing paint and energy use, improving cycle times, and finding more environmentally friendly solutions. You will also support equipment investments by defining technical requirements and taking part in testing and commissioning. In addition, you will help investigate production issues, support the technical handling of customer complaints, and work with customers, suppliers, and Wipro teams at the manufacturing sites in Perniö, Sweden, and Romania.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You have a strong practical and technical understanding of industrial surface treatment processes and experience in developing them. You understand not only individual process steps but also the whole process and how different changes can affect quality, costs, efficiency, and production. You are interested in improving processes and finding better technical solutions.

This is an independent and international role, so we value an accurate, organized, and proactive way of working as well as good communication and negotiation skills. Working with different teams, suppliers, and customers comes naturally to you, and you can adapt to changing situations. A practical and cost-conscious approach will help you succeed in this role.

**We expect you to have:**

- A relevant technical degree, for example in chemical, materials, process, production, or mechanical engineering

- Several years of relevant experience in industrial surface treatment and process development

- Strong knowledge of industrial painting and pretreatment processes, as well as electrolytic surface treatment methods

- Experience with AutoCAD and/or other technical design tools such as SolidWorks, Creo, or similar software

- Good English skills and willingness to travel to Wipros sites within Europe


**Additionally valued:**

- Experience with different surface treatment methods, such as nitrocarburizing or chromium processes

- Experience with equipment investments, commissioning, or technical development projects

- Knowledge of surface treatment testing, process requirements, or quality development


**Wipro offers you:**

- The freedom to develop surface treatment processes and make a real impact on quality, efficiency, and sustainability

- An international environment where you work across manufacturing sites and develop your technical skills

- The opportunity to develop new solutions and help shape the future of surface treatment at Wipro

- A varied expert role combining technical development, projects, and practical problem-solving

- The flexibility to work remotely from anywhere in Finland


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time and permanent position, and you will be employed directly by Wipro Infrastructure Engineering Oy. We hope you are available to start as soon as possible, depending on your notice period.

You can work either at Wipros Perniö site or remotely from anywhere in Finland. The position includes approximately 50–60 travel days per year, mainly to Wipros sites in Finland, Sweden, and Romania. Salary in this position is 4500-5500 €/month (gross), depending on the level of your experience, and will be negotiated individually.

**How to apply?**

Please submit your CV and application in PDF format in English by Monday 28th of September via aTalents application system: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/382498/create/ .

Remember to use the application system as we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure an equal recruitment process for all applicants and will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

You can learn more about Wipro Infrastructure Engineering here: https://hydraulics.wiproinfra.com/.

For more information about the position and recruitment process, please contact aTalents Recruitment Consultant Säde Juntunen (+358 44 901 2283, sade.juntunen@atalent.fi). If Im unable to answer your call right away, please leave a text message and Ill get back to you as soon as possible.

**Company description**

_Wipro Infrastructure Engineering Oy develops, manufactures, and markets high-quality hydraulic cylinders and hydraulic components under the Nummi trademark. The company is also a well-known OEM manufacturer of double-acting hydraulic cylinders. Wipro operates internationally, and about 70% of its turnover comes from exports. In addition to Finland, its main markets are Scandinavia, Poland, the Netherlands, Germany, Austria, and Switzerland._

_Wipro Infrastructure Engineering Oy is a subsidiary of the Indian company Wipro Enterprises. Its parent company, Wipro Ltd, is an international multi-business corporation listed on the New York and Mumbai stock exchanges. The company is headquartered in Bangalore, India. Wipro Infrastructure Engineering has manufacturing facilities in Finland (Perniö), Sweden, Romania, Brazil, India, Canada, and the United States._

title: Auton fiksaus ja korjaus
description:
Monipuolinen autoalan työntekijä / autopesulan työntekijä

Etsimme yritykseemme monipuolista ja motivoitunutta autoalan työntekijää. Yrityksemme tarjoaa auton pesu-, puhdistus- ja viimeistelypalveluita sekä teemme tarpeen mukaan erilaisia autojen huolto- ja korjaustöitä.

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on käytännön kokemusta useista autoalan työtehtävistä ja joka pystyy työskentelemään itsenäisesti sekä huolellisesti.

Työtehtäviin kuuluu esimerkiksi:

Vähän ymmärrystä sähköautoista.

\* autojen ulkopesu ja perusteellinen puhdistus

\* autojen sisäpuhdistus ja detailing

\* auton maalipinnan kiillotus ja myllytys

\* maalipinnan viimeistely ja mahdolliset pienet maalaustyöt

\* auton korin ja maalipinnan käsittely

\* autojen perustason huolto- ja korjaustyöt

\* moottorin ja auton teknisen toiminnan ymmärtäminen

\* auton vianmäärityksen avustavat tehtävät

\* moottorin toimintaan ja optimointiin liittyvien asioiden ymmärtäminen

\* muut autopesulan ja autokorjaamon päivittäiset tehtävät.

Edellytämme hakijalta:

\* aikaisempaa työkokemusta autoalalta

\* käytännön osaamista auton pesusta, puhdistuksesta ja kiillotuksesta

\* ymmärrystä autojen rakenteesta ja tekniikasta

\* huolellista ja vastuullista työotetta

\* kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti

\* hyvää motivaatiota oppia uusia työtehtäviä

\* valmiutta tehdä monipuolisia autoalan työtehtäviä.

Eduksi katsotaan erityisesti se, että hakijalla on kokemusta sekä autonhoidosta että autojen teknisistä korjaus- ja huoltotehtävistä. Arvostamme henkilöä, joka ymmärtää auton kokonaisuutena eikä ainoastaan autonpesua.

Työ on käytännönläheistä ja työtehtävät vaihtelevat asiakkaiden ja yrityksen tarpeiden mukaan. Sopiva henkilö voi osallistua myös yrityksen toiminnan kehittämiseen ja uusiin autoalan palveluihin.

Kielitaito: suomen kielen osaaminen katsotaan eduksi. Muu kielitaito ei ole este, mikäli hakijalla on tehtävään vaadittava ammatillinen osaaminen.

Työsuhde: kokoaikainen / määräaikainen tai toistaiseksi voimassa oleva työsuhde sovittavasta järjestelystä riippuen.

Haemme ennen kaikkea monipuolista autoalan ammattilaista, jolla on käytännön osaamista, työmoraalia ja halua kehittyä.

title: Huoltoasentaja
description:
Työssäsi huoltoasentajana keskityt pumppujen (sähkö)mekaanisiin huolto-, korjaus- ja asennustöihin sekä erilaisissa asiakaskohteissa että Flowplus Oy:n omalla palvelukeskuksella Seinäjoella. Lisäksi työhön kuuluvat muut avustavat työt työmaalla ja laitteiden valmistelu- ja korjaustyöt verstaalla. Työ sisältää matkustamista myös muualle kotimaahan sekä tarvittaessa ulkomaille.

Työsuhteesi on kokopäiväinen ja vakituinen. Viikoittainen työaikasi on 37,5 h ja työskentelet arkisin klo 8.00-16.00, mutta toivomme sinulta joustavuutta, sillä asiakaskohteissa työpäivät voivat toisinaan venyä. Flowplus Oy:lle on tärkeää, että työt hoidetaan kunnialla loppuun ja työnkuvasi edellyttääkin itsenäistä työotetta, asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä, vastuunkantoa ja tiimityötaitoja.

Tarjoamme mielenkiintoisen, monipuolisen työnkuvan vaihtelevissa työkohteissa sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi kykyjesi mukaan. Pääset jo vahvaan moniosaajien tiimiin, joka toimii tukenasi.

Työsuhteessasi sovelletaan Teknologiateollisuuden TES:iä ja palkkaus on sopimuksen mukaan.

Työsopimuksen aloitusaika sopimuksen mukaan.

Toivomme sinulta:

- monipuolista kokemusta kunnossapidosta tai sähkö- ja automaatiotyöstä

- valmiutta matkatöihin

- sopeutumiskykyä eri työkohteiden vaihteleviin olosuhteisiin ja joustoa työaikoihin kiireaikoina sekä projektien toteutuksessa

- hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä


Eduksi katsomme:

- C1-ajokortti

- sähköpätevyys S2

- sähkö- ja automaatioalan peruskoulutus


Eduksi katsomme myös koulutukset:

- työturvallisuuskortti

- tulityöturvakortti

- sähkötyöturvallisuuskoulutukset


Tarjoamme sinulle: Flowplus Oy tarjoaa sinulle vakituisen työsuhteen kasvavassa ja vakavaraisessa yhtiössä, jossa saat kattavan perehdytyksen sekä ammattitaitoiset kollegat. Flowplussalla pääset kehittymään ammatillisesti vaihtelevissa työkohteissa, eikä yksikään päivä ole samanlainen. Panostamme työhyvinvointiin ja käytössäsi ovatkin kattavat työsuhde-edut, kuten ePassi, vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutus, työsuhdepyörä sekä mahdollisuus liittyä sairauskassaan. Flowplussalla työnjälkesi näkyy ja sitä arvostetaan!

title: Myyntilupakoordinaattori
description:
Myyntiluvat-vastuualueen Regulatoriset prosessit -yksikössä koordinoidaan kansallisia ja kansainvälisiä lääkevalmisteiden myyntilupahakemuksia ja niiden muutoksia.

Myyntilupakoordinaattorin pääasiallisena tehtävänä on keskitetyn menettelyn myyntilupahakemusten käsittelyyn liittyvät hallinnolliset tehtävät ja myyntilupahakemuksiin liittyvistä prosesseista vastaaminen moniammatillisen tiimin jäsenenä.

Tehtävät koostuvat monipuolisista vastuutehtävistä kuten hakemuskäsittelyn koordinointi, hakemustilanteen raportointi sekä yhteydenpito Euroopan lääkevirastoon ja muihin EU:n lääkeviranomaisiin.

Tästä hausta voidaan täyttää myös mahdollisia määräaikaisia myyntilupakoordinaattorin virkasuhteita.

Toteutamme rekrytoinnin anonyymisti edistääksemme yhdenmukaista ja tasa-arvoista rekrytointia. Valitsemme hakijat haastatteluun ilman tietoa hakijan nimestä, iästä, sukupuolesta, paikkakunnasta (kaikki yhteystiedot), äidinkielestä, kansallisuudesta tai hakijan ulkonäöstä. Anonyymin rekrytoinnin vuoksi toivomme hakemukset ensisijaisesti sähköisessä muodossa valtiolle.fi kautta. Vältäthän myös henkilötietojesi kirjaamista hakemuksen avoimissa tekstikentissä. Mikäli kysyt puhelimitse lisätietoja tehtävästä, vältäthän kertomasta itsestäsi tietoja, jotka vaarantavat anonyymiyden. Emme vastaanota liitetiedostoja.

title: Country HR Manager
description:
_Walki transforms materials for a circular future and towards a sustainable society by extending products' life cycle and embracing resource efficiency. We are an industry leading advanced materials conversion specialist delivering transformative, sustainable solutions to solve the most demanding challenges in packaging and the built environment. Walki is a growing international group organized in three business areas: Consumer Packaging, Packaging Materials and Engineered Materials, with operations in eleven different countries, both in Europe and Asia. In 2025, the Group's annual turnover was approx. 599 million euros employing around 1600 people._

**We are looking for an experienced Country HR Manager for Walki!**

**Your role**

In this comprehensive role, you will be responsible for the entire HR function in Finland, harmonizing processes and implementing global guidelines locally. You will lead a team of HR specialists and oversee HR operations across Walki's Finnish sites, ensuring high-quality support for managers and employees while continuously developing HR practices. Beyond strategic vision, the role also calls for a pragmatic and hands-on approach supporting the business and driving HR initiatives into practice. The position can be based in Valkeakoski, Säkylä, or Pietarsaari. Walki's sites are located along the Pietarsaari-Espoo axis.

You bring strong expertise in managing the full employee lifecycle and HR processes in an industrial or manufacturing environment. You will serve as a trusted partner to site and business leaders and help supervisors succeed in their roles. Working closely with Finance and other Group functions, you will contribute to workforce planning, payroll budgeting, and people-related decision-making. In addition, you will ensure that local compensation, benefits, payroll, and HR administration practices support both compliance requirements and business objectives.

The ideal candidate is down-to-earth, collaborative, and flexible. You lead by example and act as a role model in teamwork, interaction, and communication. Safety is a core part of Walki's culture and production environment. While Walki has a separate safety organization, HR plays an important role in supporting and driving the safety culture through example. You are able to see the bigger picture while breaking it down into practical steps, building functional processes and ways of working, and putting them into practice.

**What we offer**

At Walki, you will join a highly skilled HR team. At Walki, you will work in an international organisation with a collaborative, low-hierarchy culture where people are approachable, business-focused, and committed to continuous improvement. This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in developing HR practices and supporting leaders in a growing international organisation. Walki offers a hybrid work model with up to 50 % remote work, as well as a culture benefit.

**We hope our future Country HR Manager has the following qualities and skills:**

- At least five years of experience in HR Manager-level roles in an industrial environment

- Borad experience in managing HR processes across the employee lifecycle and driving continuous improvement initiatives.

- Strong knowledge of collective agreements (experience with the paper or chemical industry collective agreements is considered a particular advantage)

- Experience implementing and harmonizing HR practices in a multi-site or international organisation. Experience and understanding of how, for example, M&A and integration processes affect HR's scope of work is considered an asset.

- Solid knowledge of employment legislation, statutory documentation, and local negotiations, along with a track record in co-operation procedures

- Ability to navigate a complex stakeholder environment involving multiple sites, collective agreements, and cross-functional collaboration within a group structure. You understand the demands of a matrix organization and corporate group structure.

- Excellent leadership and people management skills

- Fluent Finnish and English. Swedish language skills are an advantage.

- Compensation & benefits expertise is considered an advantage


While we are looking for an experienced HR professional, we also value curiosity, continuous learning, and a willingness to challenge established ways of working when opportunities for improvement exist. What matters is recognizing what you don't yet know and knowing how to find the right answers.

**Recruitment process**

We'd love to hear from you next! Please submit your application and CV through our recruitment system. The application period closes on 30 September 2026, but applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The recruitment process is managed by Jasmiina Inkinen at Valiant HR Oy (tel. 050 557 4696), who is happy to answer any questions. You can also reach Jasmiina by email at jasmiina@valianthr.fi.

First-round interviews are tentatively scheduled for weeks 40–41, with follow-up interviews in weeks 41–42. The first interview round will take place on Teams.

This recruitment is carried out in partnership with Valiant HR Oy. The successful candidate will be employed directly by Walki.

_About Valiant HR Oy:_

_Valiant HR Oy is a recruitment partner that understands both business and people. We specialize in recruitment and executive search for office, manager, and executive-level roles. Delivering a positive experience for both clients and candidates is at the heart of what we do. Learn more about us and how we work: www.valianthr.fi_

title: Laboratory Test Engineer
description:
For our client we are looking for a Laboratory Test Engineer to strengthen the project engineering team on automation and protection testing including real time simulations. 

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in power systems, testing and real time simulations. The role focuses on designing and implementing automation, protection and secondary injection tests according to customer specifications. Ideally, the candidate has a vision on how to productize simulation and testing offering. 

You will be mainly accountable for:
· Designing and implementing automation and protection testing including hardware-in-the-loop testing for power systems according to customer specifications
· Leading customer approvals and factory testing of distribution protection relays
· Maintaining the customer approval test laboratory in Vaasa
· Productizing the simulation and test offering

Qualifications For The Role:
· A B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in electrical or electrical power system engineering or equivalent
· Several years of experience working with power systems and prior experience with electrical installations or a commissioning background
· Prior experience of leading customer approvals or FATs (Factory Acceptance Testing)
· Experience with real time simulators such as RTDS, Typhoon Hil or Opal RT and relay test devices and amplifiers such as Omicron
· Experience with PSCAD or a similar software is seen as a strong benefit
· Good communication and presentation skills, including fluency in English (written and spoken), Finnish and Swedish language skills are seen as benefits

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)

- Have you previously led or participated in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) or customer approval testing for protection or automation systems?*
- Do you have hands-on experience with real-time simulation tools such as RTDS, Typhoon HIL, or OPAL-RT?*
- Do you have experience using relay testing equipment such as Omicron test sets or similar protection testing devices?*

title: Project Manager / AI Governance Lead
description:
For our client in the banking sector, were seeking a Project Manager / AI Governance Lead to lead the governance and delivery of a high-risk AI system project under the EU AI Act.

This is a combined role that merges two critical functions: project management and AI governance. The role must shape requirements, controls and evidence throughout design, build, validation and deployment.The consultant will be the regulatory-to-delivery translator, converting the AI Act into practical controls, deliverables and evidence while keeping the project on track. Knowledge of the EU AI Act risk classification and the distinct obligations it places on providers and deployers is required.

Must-have knowledge and experience:
- EU AI Act high-risk requirements
- Risk & control frameworks: ability to design operating controls, not just interpret legal text
- Regulatory implementation in practice: building governance gates, evidence models, RACI frameworks
- Project management: integrated delivery across business, technology and regulatory workstreams 

Ways of Working:
- Structured thinking, facilitation and stakeholder management
- Ability to operate in delivery mode owning a workplan, running governance gates, tracking remediation (not only advisory mode)
- Cross-functional orchestration: managing dependencies across business, AI, IT, risk, compliance, legal and privacy 

Background could include:
- AI governance/responsible AI programme delivery
- Quantitative risk analyst - Financial-services compliance or operational risk
- Technology/data risk management - Internal controls
- Regulated transformation programme management

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Have you designed and implemented operating controls for a high-risk AI system or regulated programme - not just interpreted regulatory/legal text?*
- Have you built governance gates, evidence models, and RACI frameworks as part of a regulatory implementation programme?*
- Have you owned a project workplan and tracked remediation in a delivery role (not purely advisory), while facilitating structured stakeholder engagement across senior business and risk stakeholders?*
- Have you managed cross-functional dependencies spanning business, AI/technology, IT, risk, compliance, legal, and privacy functions?*
- Do you have direct experience with the EU AI Acts high-risk classification and the differing obligations for providers vs. deployers?*

title: Asiakkuuspäällikkö
description:

Pyrit omalla työpanoksella ajamaan työyhteisöä eteenpäin ja olet valmis kouluttautumaan ja oppimaan uutta. Olet valmis ratkomaan ongelmia, etkä hätkähdä pienistä vastoinkäymisistä. Sinulla on mahdollisuus vaikuttaa omaan palkkaasi työpanoksellasi. Mahdollisuus edetä jopa eteenpäin uralla.

Suomenkielen taito välttämätön työnteon kannalta, englannin ja ruotsinkielen taito katsotaan eduksi.

Miksi juuri OXO Palvelut Oy?

Olemme uudenlainen henkilöstövuokrausyritys, jossa työntekijät eivät ole vain työntekijöitä.

Me OXOlla arvostamme jokaista työntekijää ihmisenä, eikä kukaan ole vain nimi ja numero paperilla. Pyrimme aina löytämään ratkaisun, jossa työ ja ihminen kohtaa täydellisesti toisensa.

Meidän kautta sinulla on mahdollisuus edetä uralla sekä kehittää omaa osaamistasi. Koulutamme työntekijöitämme jatkuvasti.

Jätä hakemukset sähköpostiin, jossa kerrot itsestäsi, palkka toiveesi, työkokemuksestasi sekä mahdollisista suosittelijoista Tärkeintä, että kerrot rehellisesti osaamisestasi ja itsestäsi. Haastattelemme jo hakuaikana.

title: Keittiöpäällikkö Torero ja Original Sokos Hotel Vaakuna Joensuu
description:
Primary location:
JOENSUU

Nyt on tarjolla harvoin avoinna oleva ja poikkeuksellisen monipuolinen keittiöesihenkilön tehtävä!

Etsimme innovatiivista, kehittämishaluista ja tiimihenkistä keittiöpäällikköä, joka haluaa ottaa vastuuta ruokatuotteen kehittämisestä ja johtamisesta osana Original Sokos Hotel Vaakunan kokonaisuutta Joensuun sydämessä.
Keittiöpäällikkönä vastuullasi on paljon muutakin kuin yhden ravintolan keittiö.

Pääset kehittämään useita erilaisia ruokatuotteita ja ravintolapalveluita:
Mummola-henkistä buffetlounastamme, jossa pääosassa ovat hyvä suomalainen kotiruoka ja tutut maut.
Toreron à la carte -ravintolaa, jonka iltaravintolakonsepti inspiroituu espanjalaisesta ruoka-ja juomakulttuurista.
Juhla- ja tilausravintolatoimintaa sekä erilaisia tapahtumia.
Sokos Hotels Original -aamiaista ja sen ruokatuotetta.

Tehtävässä pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan siihen, miltä tuotteemme tulevaisuudessa näyttävät ja maistuvat sekä miten keittiömme toimii. Etsimme ennen kaikkea ihmistä, jolla on näkemystä laadukkaasta ja kannattavasta ruokatuotteesta sekä halua kehittää sitä jatkuvasti yhdessä muiden keittiömestareidemme kanssa.

Et myöskään jää tehtävässä yksin. Saat ympärillesi ammattitaitoisen keittiötiimin, vahvan kollegaverkoston sekä SOK ja Sokos Hotels -ketjun tuen. Pääset kehittämään uniikkia ruokaravintolaa osana Original Sokos Hotel Vaakunan monipuolista hotelli- ja ravintolakokonaisuutta.

Tarjoamme sinulle:
Täydet työtunnit 112,5 h / 3 viikkoa.
Harvoin avoinna olevan, vastuullisen ja monipuolisen keittiöesihenkilön tehtävän.
Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa aidosti ruokatuotteeseen ja keittiön toimintatapoihin.
Monipuolisen toimintaympäristön aamiaisesta lounaaseen, à la carteen sekä juhla- ja tilaustarjoiluihin.
Ammattitaitoisen tiimin ja vahvan kollegatuen ympärillesi.
SOK ja Sokos Hotels -ketjun osaamisen ja tuen kehittämistyöhön.
Mahdollisuuden uudistaa, kokeilla ja viedä toimintaa jatkuvasti eteenpäin.

Odotamme sinulta:
Vahvaa kiinnostusta ruokaan ja ruokatuotteen kehittämiseen.
Kehittämismyönteistä, innovatiivista ja käytännönläheistä otetta.
Hyviä tiimityö- ja esihenkilötaitoja.
Kykyä johtaa keittiön päivittäistä toimintaa suunnitelmallisesti.
Ymmärrystä laadukkaasta ja kannattavasta ruokatuotteesta.
Halua tarttua tekemiseen yhdessä tiimin kanssa.
Rohkeutta tuoda esiin uusia ajatuksia ja viedä hyvät ideat myös käytäntöön.

Jos nautit ruoasta, ihmisistä, johtamisesta ja kehittämisestä – ja ajattelet, että asiat voidaan aina tehdä vielä hieman paremmin – tässä voi olla sinulle seuraava askel työurallasi.

Tervetuloa kehittämään kanssamme Toreroa ja Original Sokos Hotel Vaakunan ruokatuotetta Joensuussa!

Me tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen työnkuvan, loistavan työporukan sekä mahdollisuuden edetä urallasi. Meille on tärkeää, että työntekijöillämme on mahdollisuus oppia, kehittyä ja laajentaa omaa osaamistaan. title: Service Engineer
description:
**Location: Vantaa, Finland**

At ADB SAFEGATE, we are shaping the future of airport performance. Our solutions help airports operate more safely, efficiently, and sustainably — from aircraft approach to gate departure.

To strengthen our service team in Finland, we are looking for a motivated and hands-on **Service Engineer** to support our customers with advanced airport technology solutions.

**Your Mission**

In this role, you will be an important part of our technical team, ensuring that mission-critical airport systems are commissioned, maintained, and supported to the highest standards.

You will:

- Perform servicing, preventive maintenance, commissioning, and diagnostics of ADB SAFEGATE hardware and software systems, both on-site and remotely.

- Maintain and update technical documentation.

- Provide technical expertise and support to our customers.

- Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders while independently taking ownership of assigned tasks.

- Conduct on-site surveys and prepare technical reports.

- Represent ADB SAFEGATE professionally in all customer interactions.


**Your Profile**

We are looking for a practical, ambitious, and reliable professional who enjoys solving technical problems, working directly with customers, and taking ownership in an international environment.

**Required qualifications**

- A degree or professional qualification in Electrical Engineering, Automation Technology, Computer Science, IT, or a comparable technical field.

- Hands-on experience with electrical, automation, control, or industrial IT systems, including confidence in using technical tools, test equipment, and diagnostic software.

- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify faults across hardware, software, electrical, and control systems.

- Practical experience with low- or medium-voltage equipment and the ability to read electrical drawings and wiring diagrams.

- Professional working proficiency in Finnish and English, with the ability to communicate technical information clearly to customers and international colleagues.

- Willingness to travel up to 30%, including occasional short-notice assignments. Some commissioning and service activities may take place outside standard working hours.

- A valid Category B driving licence and willingness to travel independently to customer sites.

- Ability to manage assigned service and commissioning tasks independently while collaborating effectively with international engineering, project, and customer support teams.

- Strong customer-facing communication skills and the ability to provide professional technical support, guidance, and updates.

- A proactive and responsible approach, with strong quality awareness, customer focus, and ownership of assigned tasks.


**Preferred qualifications**

- Previous experience as a Field Service Engineer, Commissioning Engineer, System Engineer, Service Technician, or in a similar customer-facing technical role.

- Experience with airport systems, airfield lighting, industrial infrastructure, or other safety- or operationally critical systems.

- Practical knowledge of PLC systems, switchgear, control equipment, and industrial automation.

- Experience administering and troubleshooting Windows and/or Linux operating systems.

- Working knowledge of SQL databases, including basic diagnostics, queries, and system support.

- Familiarity with scripting or programming languages used for diagnostics, configuration, automation, or system integration, such as Python, Bash, batch scripting, C#, or JavaScript.

- Experience with cloud-connected systems, remote monitoring solutions, networking, or remote support tools.

- A relevant Finnish electrical safety qualification. Candidates who are eligible and willing to obtain the required qualification may also be considered.

- Knowledge of other European languages.


**What We Offer**

At **ADB SAFEGATE**, you will join an innovative industry leader where your work directly contributes to safer and smarter airport operations worldwide.

**We offer:**

- A role in a global company setting benchmarks in airport safety, efficiency, and technology.

- A dynamic work environment with challenging and meaningful projects.

- International cooperation with experienced colleagues and customers.

- Flat hierarchies, open communication, and modern working models.

- The friendly atmosphere of a medium-sized company combined with the strength of a global organization.

- Opportunities for personal development, technical training, and professional growth.

- Opportunities to work on customer projects in Finland and across Europe.

- A varied, practical, and engaging role where no two days are the same.


**Ready to Help Airports Move Smarter?**

If you are passionate about technology, enjoy hands-on fieldwork, and want to be part of an international team delivering critical airport solutions, we would like to hear from you.

**Join ADB SAFEGATE and help shape the future of safe, efficient, and sustainable airport operations.**

title: On It Films: Gameplay Capture Producer
description:
**Type:** Full-time, permanent

**Location:** Ruoholahti, Helsinki

**Application deadline:** 06.10.2026

On It Films, an in-house video partner for Supercell, is looking for a full-time Gameplay Capture Producer to join their gameplay capture team and help keep the capture process running smoothly from request to final delivery.

**About the role**

As a Gameplay Capture Producer, youll sit at the intersection of gameplay capture, post-production and clients. Youll be responsible for coordinating the schedules and priorities of seven Gameplay Capture Artists and making sure capture requests are understood and prepared correctly.

Youll work closely with the Head of Gameplay Capture, who leads the team and supports you in your work. The environment moves fast, with multiple projects running in parallel and deadlines changing quickly, so keeping production aligned and ensuring the right information reaches the right people at the right time is key.

**What youll do**

- Manage the production schedule for Gameplay Capture Artists based on project priorities, deadlines, artist availability and project needs, while maintaining a sustainable workload.

- Coordinate gameplay capture requests from start to finish, ensuring the team has the necessary information, game builds, instructions and references.

- Act as the communication bridge between Gameplay Capture, Post Production and clients, keeping schedules, requirements, priorities and potential issues aligned.

- Work closely with Post Producers to turn upcoming needs into practical capture plans and identify bottlenecks or conflicts before they impact production.

- Work directly with clients, helping clarify their requests, priorities and delivery expectations.

- Develop workflows, processes, documentation and communication together with the Head of Gameplay Capture.


**What makes you a great fit?**

Youre a strong communicator who works well with people and knows how to keep a busy production moving. Youre comfortable juggling priorities and making sure everyone has what they need to do great work.

Your background could be in game development, gameplay capture, video or post-production, VFX or animation. You dont need to know all of these inside out – what matters is the curiosity to learn the rest.

**You should have**

- Relevant experience across a mix of game development, gameplay capture, video and post-production workflows – we dont expect you to know them all.

- Strong communication skills in English across teams and clients. Whats important is the ability to translate technical or production-related information between different teams, making sure everyone understands not only what is happening, but also why it matters.

- Strong production coordination skills, with the ability to keep multiple projects moving and balance changing priorities, deadlines and team capacity.

- A genuine interest in games and curiosity to learn more about game development and gameplay capture.


**Youll be especially good at this role if you**

- Have hands-on understanding of gameplay capture and what it takes to get the right material into post-production.

- Have experience working directly with game studios and clients.

- Have a good understanding of games, gaming terminology and how games are made.

- Experience working across complex production pipelines and understanding how small changes can have a wider impact later in the process.

- Are familiar with Supercell games and the kind of gameplay capture and video production On It Films does.


**On It Films can offer you**

- Autonomy in your work, with close support from the team.

- A skilled, inspiring and welcoming team of 40+ video professionals

- Excellent environment for growth and development

- A sustainable and healthy working environment

- Great office facilities at Supercell

- Comprehensive benefits package


**Practicalities**

This is a full-time and permanent position where youll be employed by On It Films. The preferred start date would be 1st of December 2026, but this is negotiable. Your work location will be at the office in Ruoholahti, Helsinki. Youll be based on site most of the time, but once youre more familiar with the work and comfortable making independent decisions, occasional work from home is fine. Salary in this position is approximately 4500 €/month according to your skills and experience.

**Excited to keep things moving at On It Films?**

Please submit your CV and motivation letter by the latest Tuesday 6th of October 2026 via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/383566/create/.

Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. Please note, that this position is located in Finland and requires a valid work permit in Finland.

We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

Learn more about On It Films here: https://onitfilms.com/.

For more information about the position and recruitment process, please contact aTalents Senior Recruitment Consultant Kati Hautakoski (+358 50 552 0419, kati.hautakoski (at)atalent.fi). If Im unable to answer your call right away, please leave a text message and Ill get back to you as soon as possible.

title: B2B Sales and Digital Marketing Intern
description:
B2B Sales and Digital Marketing Intern

Advaun Oy · Espoo, Finland · 4–6 months · Fully Commission-based

Advaun is a Finnish software company developing manufacturing software, AI-assisted warehouse tracking and internal logistics solutions. Were looking for someone who enjoys connecting with customers and wants to help bring AI into European manufacturing.

Your responsibilities

· **Customer prospecting and research — 10% of working hours:** Identify target companies, find decision-makers and research their business needs.

· **Customer outreach — 50% of working hours:** Call prospective customers, understand their needs, follow up and book meetings. After training, the target is 20 calls per full working day, adjusted for scheduled meetings and events.

· **Meeting and demo preparation — 20% of working hours:** Work with senior managers to prepare sales materials, presentations and relevant product demonstrations.

· **Social media and website content — 10% of working hours:** Draft posts and website updates for review.

· **Industrial events, training and CRM record — 10% of working hours:** Attend events with senior colleagues, participate in training and record customer discussions and follow-up actions.

Who you are

You are a current student, thesis candidate or recent graduate in marketing, digital media, communications, sales, business development, market research, customer experience or a related field.

You are **fluent in Finnish and English. Fluency in Swedish or another European language is an asset.** You have an interest in **computer science and AI**, communicate confidently and are willing to learn. Previous sales experience is welcome but not required.

What we offer

· Product training, regular feedback and guidance from our senior team.

· Practical experience in technology sales, digital marketing and customer meetings.

· **Commission-based compensation with no fixed base salary**, subject to applicable employment and collective-agreement requirements. The commission structure will be explained during recruitment and agreed in writing before you start.

· The possibility of full-time employment after the internship, depending on performance and business needs.

**This role is entirely commission-based, with no fixed base salary. The commission structure will be agreed in writing before you start.**

This is **a full-time on-site internship** that requires **5 days a week work that lasts 4–6 months**. For current students who have unfished study requirements, we will discuss a seprate office policy agreement based on individual cases.

For thesis workers, we can discuss an separate agreement with your educational institution and a relevant thesis topic, with a separately agreed scope and time allocation.

Apply

Send your CV and a short introduction to https://forms.gle/82s3kxukFX1hT1bB8.

Please include your availability, language skills, study background and why youre interested in IT B2B sales.

If you have any further questions, please feel free to call +358451715538.

title: VASTAANOTTOVIRKAILIJA (sijaisuus) Original Sokos Hotel Vaakuna ja Lakeus, Seinäjoki
description:
Primary location:
SEINÄJOKI

Seinäjoki on avaruuden pääkaupunki, jossa on tilaa kaikelle hyvälle. Seinäjoella on tilaa asua ja kasvaa, tilaa yrittää ja menestyä. On tilaa toteuttaa itseään, tilaa tavoitella unelmiaan ja tilaa olla rohkea. Ennen kaikkea tilaa on onnistumiselle, onnelle ja hyvälle elämälle. Tässä tapahtumiensuurkaupungissa, Aalto- keskuksen välittömässä läheisyydessä sijaitsevat hotellimme Original Sokos Hotel Lakeus ja Vaakuna.

VASTAANOTTOVIRKAILIJA (sijaisuus) Original Sokos Hotel Vaakuna ja Lakeus, Seinäjoki

Hotelliemme vastaanottojen tiimit luovat asiakkaillemme onnistuneen majoituskokemuksen aina saapumisesta lähtöhetkeen saakka. Tässä tehtävässä huolehdit vieraistamme iloisella, palveluhenkisellä ja ratkaisukeskeisellä otteella sekä varmistat, että jokainen asiakas tuntee itsensä tervetulleeksi.

Arvostamme aikaisempaa kokemusta hotellin vastaanottotyöstä sekä Opera - varausjärjestelmän tuntemusta. Myös hyvät IT - taidot katsotaan eduksi. Tärkeintä on kuitenkin positiivinen, energinen ja sydämellinen asiakaspalveluasenne, kyky itsenäiseen työskentelyyn sekä halu oppia ja kehittyä. Asiakaspalvelutyössä tarvitset sekä suomen että englannin kielen taitoa onnistuaksesi.
